title: Senior Director Mobile Apps
description:
GROW YOUR CAREER WITH US
At Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings (NCLH), we know our future success depends on our ability to attract and retain the very best talent. Our brands deliver vacations of a lifetime with innovative product offerings, a high level of service and unique guest experiences aboard each vessel and we’re continually seeking applicants who are passionate about hospitality and committed to being their personal best. As you learn more about our company, we think you will agree that there is no better time than now to become a member of the NCLH family!

APPLY ONLINE
If you’re interested to be considered for this position, please click the blue APPLY button at the top of the page to get started. All candidates must complete an on-line application to be considered.

Job Summary

The Senior Director, Mobile Applications is responsible for enterprise-wide execution and operational excellence of all branded mobile applications across the full guest journey. This role leads Research, Design, Experimentation, Product Management, and Front-End Technology for mobile platforms supporting acquisition, pre-cruise, onboard, post-cruise, and offline experiences. The Senior Director is accountable for translating stakeholder-defined product priorities into high-quality, scalable, and reliable mobile solutions through disciplined execution of the software development lifecycle (SDLC). The Senior Director oversees budgets, planning, stakeholder alignment, and delivery of projects, enhancements, and maintenance initiatives while managing a hybrid model of internal teams and managed service provider (MSP) partners. This role ensures innovation, scalability, and measurable business value while driving AI adoption and future AI product integration within the mobile ecosystem. This role consults to and understands, but does not own, mobile product strategy, prioritization, or business performance metrics, but is accountable for delivery excellence, technical integrity, release predictability, and operational performance of mobile platforms.

Position Responsibilities

  • Partner with stakeholders to translate mobile product strategies and priorities into executable delivery roadmaps.
  • Provide input to inform feasibility, sequencing, capacity planning, and dependency management.
  • Lead multidisciplinary teams spanning Product Management, UX/UI Design, Research, Front-End Engineering, Release Management, and Experimentation functions.
  • Oversee delivery of all mobile initiatives including large-scale projects, feature enhancements, experimentation programs, and production maintenance.
  • Own and continuously improve the end-to-end mobile SDLC, including intake, estimation, sprint execution, release management, and post-release support.
  • Ensure predictable, transparent, and measurable delivery performance across internal and MSP teams.
  • Partner with key stakeholders to inform the full mobile guest journey strategy, ensuring seamless experiences from acquisition through post-cruise engagement, including offline functionality.
  • Partner closely with Core Services/Back-End teams and upstream systems (e.g., Reservation Systems, Shipboard Property Management Systems (SPMS), and enterprise platforms) to ensure integration alignment and data continuity.
  • Manage operating and capital budgets, resource and capacity planning, and financial forecasting for the mobile portfolio.
  • Collaborate with Tech Strategy Team on vendor contracts, including SaaS providers.
  • Direct mixed delivery model of internal FTE pods and MSP/vendor pods to ensure scalable and efficient execution.
  • Report on delivery performance metrics, including release predictability, cycle time, defect rates, system stability, platform performance, and technical health indicators.
  • Provide transparent executive reporting on roadmap execution, risks, dependencies, and capacity trade-offs.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to establish KPIs and performance metrics related to adoption, revenue impact, engagement, operational efficiency, and guest satisfaction that can then be tracked and reported against.
  • Lead experimentation and A/B/x testing strategies to optimize conversion, usability, and engagement and ensure that scalable mobile experimentation frameworks are built, maintained, and reliably executed.
  • Own AI strategy within mobile teams, leveraging AI tools to improve team productivity, automate workflows, and drive operational efficiency.
  • Enable the incorporation of AI-driven products and capabilities into mobile guest experiences.
  • Ensure governance, security, compliance, and performance standards are consistently met across all mobile applications.
  • Serve as liaison to relevant brand, operations, marketing, revenue management, and technology stakeholders.
  • Champion innovation, collaboration, transparency, and passion across mobile and cross-functional teams.
  • Build and develop a high-performing mobile organization, including succession planning, leadership development, and operating model clarity across internal and MSP resources
  • Perform other job-related duties as assigned.
  • This role owns “how” mobile solutions are delivered — not “what” is prioritized or the commercial performance of those solutions.

Degree Type: Bachelor's Degree

Fields of Study: Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business Administration, Digital Media or Related Field. Master’s Degree preferred

EXPERIENCE

  • Minimum of 10+ years of progressive experience in digital product management, mobile application development, AI/LLM, and/or technology leadership.
  • Minimum of 6+ years of senior leadership experience managing managers and cross-functional digital teams.
  • Experience leading enterprise-scale applications supporting large user bases across multiple brands or business units.
  • Experience managing hybrid delivery models (internal teams and external vendors/MSPs).
  • Experience overseeing budgets, financial forecasting, and vendor contracts.
  • Experience integrating applications with complex enterprise systems and APIs.
  • Experience leading experimentation frameworks and digital optimization initiatives.
  • Experience implementing or scaling AI-driven capabilities within digital products preferred.

Preferred:

  • Experience in hospitality, travel, cruise, gaming, or consumer-facing digital ecosystems.
  • Experience supporting distributed or shipboard-connected technology environments.

COMPETENCIES & SKILLS

  • Strong enterprise leadership and executive presence.
  • Proven ability to drive operational excellence across complex mobile application portfolios.
  • Deep understanding of Agile delivery models, SDLC governance, and mobile release management.
  • Strong financial acumen including budget oversight, forecasting, and portfolio investment management.
  • Experience leading hybrid internal and MSP/vendor delivery models.
  • Solid technical fluency across native mobile platforms, APIs, enterprise integrations, and performance standards.
  • Understanding of distributed and offline-capable mobile environments.
  • Data-driven mindset with familiarity in experimentation and optimization frameworks.
  • Understanding of AI/LLM capabilities and their application within mobile platforms.
  • Strong organizational leadership, talent development, and succession planning capabilities.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder alignment skills.

CERTIFICATIONS & LICENSES

Relevant certifications in product management, Agile methodologies, digital strategy, AI/ML, or cloud technologies preferred but not required

Norwegian Cruise Line Holdings Ltd. (NYSE: NCLH) is a leading global cruise company which operates the Norwegian Cruise Line®, Oceania Cruises® and Regent Seven Seas Cruises® brands. The combined brands currently operate 32 ships, employ over 35,000 shipboard crew from more than 110 different countries and visit approximately 700 different port destination each year.

title: Pharmacy Senior CX Professional
description:
Become a part of our caring community

The Pharmacy Senior Consumer Experience (CX) Professional enhances the consumer experience across our Traditional Mail and Specialty Mail Order Pharmacies through insight-driven analysis and collaboration, supporting continuous improvement projects. You will translate customer experience data into applicable insights and support end-to-end journey improvements. You apply judgment, analytical rigor, and communication to influence outcomes, ensuring informed decision-making, and support consumer-centered improvement projects across the organization. You will provide daily work guidance and subject matter support to CX professionals to ensure delivery of insights and improvement activities. You will report to the Consumer Experience Lead.

You will support the delivery and continuous improvement of the consumer experience by managing experience insights, supporting improvement work, and partnering with teams. You will apply deep consumer experience expertise within an established strategy, governance model, and toolset, contributing to consumer-centered improvements through rigorous analysis, coordination, and hands-on execution. You will influence outcomes through insight translation, facilitation, and data-driven recommendations rather than formal authority.

Responsibilities:

Patient Experience Measurement & Insight

  • Manage and analyze patient experience inputs, including transactional and relationship NPS, CAHPS, HOS, and other voice-of-the-customer sources.
  • Summarize quantitative and qualitative data into clear applicable insights and themes to inform experience improvement priorities.
  • Work with Operations and partners (e.g., Product, Legal, Technology) to interpret customer experience insights, identify causes, and resolve systemic experience issues.
  • Translate enterprise strategy into clear execution-level insights and improvement recommendations.
  • Present recommendations using compelling storytelling tailored to senior leadership and operational audiences.

description:

At Shelter, we do not require a previous background in the insurance industry. While the experience is a plus, it is far from a necessity. title: Lead Cell Therapy Specialist

description:
In this role, you will lead and coordinate daily manufacturing execution, ensuring personnel, materials, equipment, documentation, and cleanroom areas are ready before operations begin.   • GMP experience: Experience working in a cGMP manufacturing environment
  • Technical skills: Experience with aseptic technique, cleanroom behavior, cell culture operations, and single-use technologies
  • Leadership capability: Proven ability to lead work on the manufacturing floor and guide team members during execution
  • Documentation and quality knowledge: Strong understanding of SOPs, batch records, production records, and quality systems

Working Conditions

title: Vice President, Professional Services
description:
US Salary: $228,000 - $265,000 w/25% annual bonus

About Us

Bonterra exists to propel every doer of good to their peak impact. We measure that impact against our vision to increase the giving rate as a percentage of GDP from 2% to 3% by 2033. We know that this goal is lofty, but we are confident that the right technology and expertise will strengthen trust in the sector, allowing the social good industry to accelerate growth and reach peak impact. Bonterra's differentiated, end-to-end solutions collectively support a unique network of over 20,000 customers, including over 16,000 nonprofit organizations and over 50 percent of Fortune 100 companies. Learn more at bonterratech.com.

About the Role

The Vice President, Professional Services is accountable for the strategy, execution, and financial performance of Bonterra's NPO-focused services organization that covers case management and fundraising solutions business units, encompassing implementation, post-go-live value delivery, technical account management, advanced support, and data engineering functions. This role leads a globally distributed team across multiple practice areas, owns the full P&L for NPO Services, and serves as the primary executive sponsor for large-scale, complex customer engagements. Leveraging AI-enhanced delivery models and automation-first methodologies, this leader drives time-to-value improvements, margin optimization, and service portfolio expansion across a diverse customer base of nonprofit and social good organizations.

Operating as a key partner to Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Support, the Vice President ensures Professional Services functions as a strategic growth asset for Bonterra's commercial motion while translating customer insights into product evolution and service innovation. This role holds organizational accountability for delivery quality, team capability development, and multi-year services strategy.

Bonterra is a technology company that builds software platforms enabling nonprofit organizations to raise funds, manage volunteers, and administer the programs they deliver to the communities they serve.

What You'll Do

  • Lead a globally distributed Professional Services organization comprising business analysts, implementation consultants, project managers, technical account managers, advanced support consultants, developers, quality analysts, and data engineers, ensuring team members are aligned, enabled, and performing against defined service delivery standards.

  • Own and actively manage the NPO Services P&L, driving margin and utilization optimization to consistently deliver on financial targets across a multi-product, multi-segment services business.

  • Define and execute a multi-year vision and operating strategy for NPO Professional Services, positioning the function as a force multiplier for Bonterra's commercial organization and a driver of customer adoption and retention.

  • Design and continuously optimize a fungible services delivery model that scales across Bonterra's multi-product portfolio, enabling resource flexibility and delivery consistency across customer segments ranging from small nonprofits to large enterprise organizations.

  • Develop and launch new service offerings by building business cases, engaging cross-functional stakeholders, and managing full-cycle launches from conception through commercialization.

  • Drive adoption of AI-powered delivery tools and automation frameworks across the NPO Services team to improve time-to-value, reduce delivery cost, and elevate the customer experience.

  • Sponsor and actively manage major customer escalations, complex delivery engagements, and high-stakes implementation programs, providing executive-level oversight and resolution authority.

  • Partner with Sales as a strategic asset in the pre-sales and expansion motion, bringing services expertise to field conversations and contributing to commercial pipeline and revenue outcomes.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Customer Success, and Support to surface customer insights from delivery and translate field learnings into product roadmap input and service innovation.

  • Coach and develop Professional Services leaders, enabling each to grow and optimize their respective business area, team performance, and service portfolio.

  • Establish and maintain strategic partnerships with offshore delivery providers and channel/partner organizations to extend services capacity and delivery capability in a cost-effective manner.

  • Define and govern delivery methodology, role frameworks, and practice team structures to ensure consistency, scalability, and alignment with industry best practices.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

LEADERSHIP & NAVIGATION EXPECTATIONS

  • This position has direct people management responsibilities across a globally distributed, multi-practice Professional Services organization, including accountability for hiring, performance, development, and organizational structure for managers and individual contributors across multiple functional disciplines.

KEY BEHAVIORS — THE "HOW"

  • Operates with enterprise-level strategic awareness, bringing a long-horizon perspective to services architecture decisions, talent strategy, and cross-functional alignment. Builds high-trust relationships with executive peers and external stakeholders through transparent communication, sound judgment, and a demonstrated commitment to customer and employee outcomes. Models AI-first and data-driven approaches in decision-making, delivery design, and team development.

OUTCOME EXPECTATIONS — THE "IMPACT"

  • Accountable for delivering a balanced P&L that reflects disciplined financial management, margin targets, and utilization benchmarks. Drives measurable improvement in time-to-value across the NPO customer base, increases services attach and expansion revenue, and builds a scalable delivery organization capable of supporting Bonterra's growth trajectory. Elevates Professional Services as a named strategic differentiator in Bonterra's go-to-market motion.

Required Minimum Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience leading professional services or services delivery organizations within a SaaS or technology company, including full P&L ownership and accountability for delivery performance across commercial and enterprise customer segments.

  • Proven ability to design, implement, and evolve services delivery methodology and practice team structures in a complex, multi-product business environment.

  • Track record of building and leading globally distributed, high-performing teams across geographically dispersed locations, including offshore and nearshore delivery models.

  • Demonstrated experience influencing at the executive and C-Suite level, including the ability to present business cases, navigate organizational complexity, and drive alignment on strategic direction.

  • Experience developing and executing multi-year organizational strategy, including identification of new service offerings, go-to-market enablement, and financial modeling.

  • Ability to partner cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Customer Success, and Support functions in a matrixed organization to drive shared outcomes.

  • Strong data and analytical orientation, with the ability to interpret operational metrics, financial results, and customer health signals to make informed decisions and course corrections.

  • Experience championing and operationalizing AI-enhanced workflows, automation tools, or technology-enabled delivery models within a services context.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 15 or more years of progressive experience leading services sales and delivery across commercial and enterprise segments, with at least 10 years in a Professional Services leadership role in a SaaS company with annual revenue of $300 million or more.

  • 10 or more years of experience defining and evolving delivery methodology and role frameworks in a Professional Services environment, including practice area design and workforce model development.

  • Experience within or adjacent to the nonprofit, social good, or government technology sectors, with working knowledge of the funding, compliance, and operational environment in which NPO customers operate.

  • Familiarity with Certinia (FinancialForce), Salesforce, or Monday.com in a services operations context.

  • Experience building and managing partner/channel and offshore delivery programs, including vendor governance, quality oversight, and commercial structure.

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Management, or a related discipline; MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead organizational change and drive a culture of continuous improvement and innovation at scale.

At Bonterra, we’re innovating with a higher purpose: to increase giving to 3% of US GDP by 2033, creating $573 billion more in global impact every year. description:

Wednesday 12 August 2026

Flexible Working Options

Hybrid Working, Job Share

Job Description Summary

.

Job Description

JOB TITLE: Design Researcher (12 Month FTC)

SALARY: The salary banding is £72,702 - £80,780

LOCATION: London

HOURS: 35 hours, full time

WORKING PATTERN: Our work style is hybrid, which involves spending at least two days per week, or 40% of our time, at one of our office sites.

About this opportunity

Here at Lloyds Banking Group, we value Design Research. We’re a large, experienced team of 40+ researchers. We shape product and service development. Everyone has different strengths and passions... maybe you’re an expert in accessibility, skilled in quantitative research, or have a solid background in user experience (UX). We'll encourage you to test and learn new ways of doing research and foster a culture of mentoring, collaborating, and learning from other researchers.

What will I be doing?

Working in a multi-disciplinary design, product, and engineering team, you’ll develop and lead the research strategy for a key area of our business, Embedded Finance. You’ll also be supported by our wider Design Research and Analytics community.

You’ll be responsible for managing the research plan and roadmap for your service or product area. You’ll deliver research to solve customer problems, unlock new opportunities, and guide what is created.

You’ll enjoy working on varied research across the product development lifecycle, from generative to evaluative research.

Why Lloyds Banking Group

Join us and, give us your best and we’ll give you ours. Here, you’ll make a difference to customers, you’ll enjoy a fulfilling career where you’re free to be yourself. Great colleagues, amazing workspaces, hybrid working and huge career opportunities-you’ll find them all here.

What you’ll need

  • 5+ years’ experience of working closely with design and product teams to identify and prioritise the right research questions

  • Able to create research roadmaps and plans to keep the team on track, helping set both short term objectives and strategic direction

  • Deep qualitative research experience using techniques such as usability testing (moderated and unmoderated), concept testing, and depth interviews

  • Synthesise insights in an impactful and actionable manner to generate a shared understanding of user needs and opportunities

  • Able to communicate and influence wider business stakeholders with clarity and conciseness

  • Experience combining qualitative and quantitative methods

  • Experience of planning and executing exploratory/ discovery research

  • Ethnographic experience (such as contextual enquiry or diary studies)

  • Experience triangulating research and data from different sources to tell compelling customer stories

We know that great talent comes from many backgrounds. Whilst this job advert may reference specific years of experience, we recognise that skills are developed in many ways, so if you have relevant, transferable experience, we encourage you to apply.

About working for us

Our focus is to ensure we're inclusive every day, building an organisation that reflects modern society and celebrates diversity in all its forms. We want our people to feel that they belong and can be their best, regardless of background, identity or culture.

We were one of the first major organisations to set goals on diversity in senior roles, create a menopause health package, and a dedicated Working with Cancer initiative. And it’s why we especially welcome applications from under-represented groups.

We’re disability confident. So if you’d like reasonable adjustments to be made to our recruitment processes, just let us know.

We also offer a wide ranging benefits package, which includes:

  • A generous pension contribution of up to 15%

  • An annual performance related bonus

  • Share schemes including free shares

  • Benefits you can adapt to your lifestyle, such as discounted shopping

  • 30 days’ holiday, with bank holidays on top

  • A range of wellbeing initiatives and generous parental leave policies

Want to do amazing work, that’s interesting and makes a difference to millions of people? Join our journey.

At Lloyds Banking Group, we're driven by a clear purpose; to help Britain prosper. Across the Group, our colleagues are focused on making a difference to customers, businesses and communities. title: Risk Mgmt Policy Analyst
description:
The Risk Management Policy Analyst will be responsible for leading efforts to shape risk management policy, leveraging industry knowledge and experience. Support the Senior Director, Risk Policy, Recovery & Resolution in building out risk management policies related to current and evolving regulatory obligations, with specific focus on CFTC regulations. The Risk Management Policy Associate must have strong knowledge of U.S. regulatory requirements for clearing houses and be able to apply that knowledge to Clearing House rules and services.

The Risk Management Policy Analyst will be responsible for establishing and maintaining risk management policies consistent with relevant regulations, including relating to the recovery and wind-down plans for CME Group’s clearing services. Additionally, to address evolving regulatory frameworks, the Risk Management Policy Associate will:

  • Develop and execute strategic policy positions (e.g., comment letters and talking points) in coordination with other key internal stakeholders. Ensure effective communication and presentation of initiatives to internal and external stakeholders (e.g., clients and regulatory bodies).

  • Support development for major project initiatives within the Clearing House from a policy perspective, including in response to regulatory changes and new business plans.

  • Lead the effort to keep CME Clearing's senior management appraised of various regulatory developments affecting the Clearing House. Work closely with others within and outside of the Clearing House, including Legal.

  • Liaise and build relationships with with trade associations as they develop their policy positions, including in response to recent policy proposals.

The Risk Management Policy Analyst will work across groups to evaluate requirements and assess the impact to CME Group and our clients.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in economics, finance, political science, or related field.

  • Possess strong written communication skills and analytical and problem-solving skills, along with being highly detail oriented with respect to drafting policies and analyzing complex regulatory requirements relative to CME Group’s rules.

  • Knowledge of CFTC regulatory requirements and more broadly, knowledge of financial markets and derivatives products.

  • Ability to work in a highly collaborative team environment.

CME Group is committed to offering a competitive total rewards package for our employees that recognizes their contributions to the business and reflects our long-term investment in their future. The pay range for this role is $81,100-$135,100. Actual salary offered will be dependent on a wide array of factors including but not limited to: relevant experience, skills, education and comparison to internal employees (where relevant). Our compensation program also includes an annual target bonus opportunity for all employees, as well as the opportunity to become an owner in the company through our broad-based equity program. Through our benefits program, we strive to offer flexibility, value and choice. From comprehensive health coverage, to a retirement package that includes both a 401(k) and an active pension plan, to highly competitive education reimbursement provisions, paid time off and a mental health benefit, CME Group offers a holistic benefits package for our team and their dependents.

CME Group: Where Futures are Made

CME Group is the world’s leading derivatives marketplace. But who we are goes deeper than that. Here, you can impact markets worldwide. Transform industries. And build a career by shaping tomorrow. We invest in your success and you own it – all while working alongside a team of leading experts who inspire you in ways big and small. Problem solvers, difference makers, trailblazers. Those are our people. And we’re looking for more.

At CME Group, we embrace our employees' unique experiences and skills to ensure that everyone’s perspectives are acknowledged and valued. As an equal-opportunity employer, we consider all potential employees without regard to any protected characteristic.

Important Notice: Recruitment fraud is on the rise, with scammers using misleading promises of job offers and interviews to solicit money and personal information from job seekers. CME Group adheres to established procedures designed to maintain trust, confidence and security throughout our recruitment process. Learn more here.

description:
“I can be myself at work.”

You are more than a job title. We want you to feel comfortable doing great work and bringing your best, authentic self to everything you do. We value your talents, traditions, and uniqueness—and we’re committed to fostering a strong sense of belonging in a respectful workplace.

You want to feel recognized at work. Your performance will be reviewed annually, and your compensation will be designed to motivate and reward the value that you provide. You’ll receive a competitive salary, bonuses and benefits. Your company-funded retirement contribution will factor in salary and variable pay, including bonuses.

“I can lead a full life.”

You bring unique goals and interests to your job and your life. Whether you’re raising a family, you’re passionate about where you volunteer, or you want to explore different career paths, we’ll give you the resources that can set you up for success.

  • Receive 2-for-1 matching gifts for your charitable contributions and the opportunity to secure annual grants for the organizations you love

  • Access on-demand professional development resources that allow you to hone existing skills and learn new ones

Capital Group is the world’s largest active fund manager. As a privately held company with a strong financial foundation, we have been free to prioritize our clients’ best interests and objectives for nearly a century. Success in that regard has helped spur our growth, leading to a scale that enables us to offer competitive fees and continue to develop new capabilities for our clients.

The Director of Risk & Corporate Insurance leads Capital Group’s global insurance and risk financing strategy to protect the firm’s balance sheet, operations, and fiduciary outcomes. Accountable for identifying, quantifying, and mitigating enterprise risk exposures through effective risk transfer, governance, and integration of insurance into the broader risk management framework.

Key Responsibilities

  • Set strategic direction for the global insurance and risk financing program, including limits, retention strategy, and market approach.

  • Lead underwriting strategy, policy placement, and renewal negotiations to optimize terms, pricing, and long-term positioning.

  • Evaluate enterprise risk exposures using loss data and analytics to inform risk transfer and mitigation decisions.

  • Integrate risk and insurance considerations into business activities, including contracts, vendor relationships, and corporate initiatives.

  • Ensure compliance with global regulatory insurance requirements and evolving market standards.

  • Oversee claims and litigation in partnership with Legal, ensuring effective recovery and continuous improvement of risk practices.

  • Deliver clear, decision-oriented risk reporting and insights to senior leadership, boards, and committees.

  • Drive continuous improvement of risk frameworks, tools, and processes to enhance transparency and scalability.

  • Provides leadership to the Global Risk & Insurance function, including day to day delivery and building and developing the team.

  • Engages with senior executives, business leaders, and governance bodies to provide independent, data-driven risk perspectives.

  • Leads complex, cross-functional risk initiatives spanning multiple jurisdictions and regulatory environments.

  • Advances innovative approaches to risk financing, analytics, and program design to enhance resilience and efficiency.

Knowledge & Experience

  • Deep expertise in insurance risk management, including program design, underwriting, claims, and risk transfer.

  • Broad understanding of the asset management business and enterprise risk domains (operational, regulatory, financial).

  • Strong knowledge of global insurance markets and regulatory environments.

  • Proven ability to influence senior leadership on complex, high-impact risk issues.

  • Recognized as a trusted advisor with strong judgment, analytical rigor, and enterprise perspective.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead and develop a team of risk and insurance professionals.

  • Ability to work cross functionally and drive results in a complex, matrixed global organization.

You’ve reviewed this job posting and you’re ready to start the candidate journey with us. Apply now to move to the next step in our recruiting process. If this role isn’t what you’re looking for, check out our other opportunities and join our talent community.

“I can learn more about Capital Group.”

At Capital Group, the success of the people who invest with us depends on the people in whom we invest. That’s why we offer a culture, compensation and opportunities that empower our associates to build successful and prosperous careers. Through nine decades, our goal has been to improve people’s lives through successful investing. We know that our history is a testament to the strength of the people we hire. title: Part-Time Oil Change Team Member - Shop#367 - 12518 San Jose Boulevard
description:
Company:Take 5 Oil Change

We invite you to join us at Take 5!

Take 5 Oil Change is your neighborhood go-to oil change spot. We've been doing this for over 35 years now and we pride ourselves in our friendly technicians, our oil change expertise, and our efficient process that gets you on your way safely and swiftly. All while letting you stay in the comfort of your car or truck while we change your oil.

We're always looking for friendly and energetic team members to join our family. Technicians, managers, and more positions are available across the country. With our Pit Tech to President growth path, Take 5 is where you can invest in yourself while we invest in you. In fact, over 90% of our field leaders are internal promotions!

JOB DESCRIPTION:

Part-Time Oil Change Team Member

Are you a people person? Self-Motivated? Do you love working with cars?

If so, here is good news for you! Take 5 Oil Change is offering an opportunity to showcase your skills and join our growing team of part-time crew members and lube techs!

No experience required!

We will train you how to be a lube technician who can change oil, replace wiper blades/air filters, fill air in tires, and perform other light maintenance services. All you need to do is be willing to learn, work hard, and bring a positive attitude to the shop!

Up to $15/hr with base pay and commissions!

Some of our most successful lube technicians are those that joined the team with no experience at all, but many others were once servers, restaurant workers, mechanics, retail employees, landscapers, and other skilled trade workers!

Move up fast!

Over 90% of our Shop Managers started as lube techs. We provide PAID TRAINING to help our team members advance through the company and become Take 5 leaders who earn salaries and bonuses!

What our crew members love about Take 5:

  • Part-time schedules are available
  • Paid Weekly
  • Earn competitive base pay rates & weekly bonuses
  • FREE oil changes!

As a Take 5 crew member, your job will be to:

  • Drain motor oil, change oil filter
  • Wash windshield and adjust tire pressure
  • Inspect and top off fluids
  • Perform coolant exchanges
  • Restock and maintain inventory levels on the floor
  • Maintain cleanliness of work environment
  • Provide excellent customer service

All our crew members need to meet the following requirements:

  • Must be able to lift to fifty (50) pounds
  • Must be able to maneuver in and out of a shallow 3’ deep pit to position yourself safely under cars
  • Must be able to walk, stand, bend, stoop, twist, etc. for extended periods of time and perform activities involving holding, grasping, pulling, and turning
  • Must be willing to work in hot/cold weather conditions if necessary
  • Must have reliable transportation to and from the shop

title: Facilities Security Officer
description:
Who We Are; What We Do; Where We’re Going
Magnet Forensics is a global leader in the development of digital investigative software that acquires, analyzes, and shares evidence from computers, smartphones, tablets, and IoT-related devices. We are continually innovating so our customers can deploy advanced and effective tools to protect their companies, communities, and countries.
Serving thousands of customers globally, our solutions are playing a crucial role in modernizing digital investigations, helping investigators fight crime, protect assets, and guard national security.
With employees based around the world, Magnet Forensics has been expanding our global presence. As a part of Magnet Forensics, you can expect to make a difference in the world, no matter what role you play. You’ll be supported through learning and development, not to mention an incredible team with unbelievable talent and integrity.
If you think you would be the right person to join our team working towards this goal, we would love to hear from you!

Role Overview

Are you passionate about security, compliance, and supporting mission-critical work? We're looking for a highly organized and detail-oriented Facilities Security Officer (FSO) to lead and maintain our government security clearance programs.

In this role, you will serve as the primary administrator of the company's Facility Clearance (FCL) and personnel security clearance program, helping ensure our continued ability to perform classified work for Government customers. You will also play a critical role in managing compliance with Foreign Ownership, Control, or Influence (FOCI) requirements, supporting facility clearance eligibility, government reporting obligations, and mitigation activities. You'll partner with employees, leadership, government representatives, and cross-functional teams to maintain compliance, support cleared personnel and strengthen our overall security posture.

NOTE: Candidate must reside in Virginia.

What You'll Do

Manage Facility Security & FOCI Compliance

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for facility clearance administration and government security matters.

  • Maintain the organization's Facility Clearance (FCL) and support all required compliance activities, reporting, and documentation.

  • Coordinate government inspections, audits, self-assessments, and security reviews.

  • Monitor organizational changes involving ownership, governance, key management personnel, investments, acquisitions, and foreign business relationships that could impact facility clearance eligibility.

  • Support the administration of Foreign Ownership, Control, or Influence (FOCI) compliance requirements, mitigation agreements, reporting obligations, and related government filings.

  • Partner with Legal, Finance, HR, and Corporate Development teams to evaluate potential FOCI implications arising from corporate transactions, ownership changes, and strategic partnerships.

  • Develop and maintain security policies, procedures, and records that support classified operations and regulatory compliance.

Administer Personnel Security Clearances

  • Manage the full lifecycle of employee security clearances, including initial applications, renewals, upgrades, periodic reviews, transfers, and terminations.

  • Guide employees through security clearance requirements and application processes.

  • Maintain accurate security records and monitor clearance status and eligibility.

  • Coordinate onboarding, security briefings, debriefings, and ongoing compliance requirements for cleared personnel.

  • Act as a trusted resource for employees and managers on personnel security matters.

Drive Security Program Compliance

  • Conduct internal audits to ensure continued compliance with security requirements.

  • Track corrective actions and support remediation of identified findings.

  • Maintain audit-ready documentation and evidence.

  • Support reporting of security incidents, violations, and compliance concerns as required.

  • Develop compliance metrics and security program reporting for leadership.

Promote Security Awareness

  • Deliver security orientation and annual refresher training programs.

  • Develop educational materials and communications that promote a strong culture of security.

  • Stay informed on regulatory updates and industry best practices and translate them into actionable guidance for the organization.

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree in Security Management, Criminal Justice, Business Administration, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Experience administering U.S. Government facility security clearance and government personnel security clearance programs.

  • Strong understanding of the National Industrial Security Program (NISP) and facility clearance requirements.

  • Experience supporting security compliance programs, audits, inspections, and regulatory reporting.

  • Knowledge of Foreign Ownership, Control, or Influence (FOCI) regulations and their impact on cleared contractors.

  • Exceptional organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage sensitive information.

  • Strong communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.

Nice to Have Skills

  • Previous experience serving as a Facility Security Officer (FSO) within a cleared contractor environment.

  • Direct experience administering or supporting FOCI mitigation arrangements.

  • Active or previously held U.S. Government security clearance.

  • Experience supporting organizations performing classified work for the Department of Defense and other U.S. Government agencies.

  • Familiarity with facility clearance management and personnel clearance processing systems.

Compensation & Benefits

The Compensation range is for the primary location for which the job is posted. Please note that the actual compensation may vary depending on location and job-related factors such as qualifications, experience, knowledge and skills. If you are applying for this role outside of the primary location and you are selected for an interview, the Talent Acquisition Partner can share more information with you. Indicators of Success

It’s more important to us to find candidates who can display indicators of success through skills they have developed and experiences they have been a part of, than to find folks who have “been there, done that”. We want to be part of your development journey, and we’ll learn as much from you as you learn from us.
How We Work
At Magnet Forensics, we take a hybrid-flexible approach to support your productivity and work-life balance. If you’re within a comfortable travel distance to one of our offices, you’ll occasionally join us in person. How often you’ll come in depends on your department and team needs, typically ranging from weekly to monthly. These in-person moments help us build stronger connections, spark new ideas, and celebrate our successes together. Most days, you can choose what works best for you, while staying in tune with your team’s goals.
We’re excited to welcome you to our team and look forward to achieving great things together - both in the office and wherever you work best!

CARE – We care about each other and our mission to make a difference in the world.
OWN – We are accountable for our results – while never forgetting to act with integrity, empathy, and respect.

title: Applications Sr Analyst - Clinical Trials
description:
Serious Medicine is what we do. Being extraordinary is who we are. Every colleague plays a key role in upholding this promise to our patients and their families.

Shift:

First Shift (United States of America)

Applications Sr Analyst - Clinical Trials

Are you a Tech-savvy analyst who loves turning complex clinical trial protocols, regulatory requirements, and research workflows into seamless, compliant system solutions? At Nebraska Medicine—home to the Fred & Pamela Buffett Cancer Center and one of the nation’s leading academic health systems—we’re searching for a Clinical Trials Application Systems Analyst to own the build, optimization, and support of our Advarra Research suite (Epic integration, Protocol Schedule of Events, Regulatory compliance, and study financials). If you’re already in the Omaha area, love partnering directly with oncologists, study coordinators, and research teams, and get a rush from seeing your configurations power life-changing clinical trials, this is your opportunity to make a tangible difference in cancer care and cutting-edge research every single day.

Details: Applications Sr Analyst - Clinical Trials

  • Candidate must live in Nebraska or Iowa
  • This is a hybrid position, must be able to work on campus
  • Preferred consideration will be given to applicants with Advarra Applications and Docusign Administration experience
  • Resume REQUIRED for consideration

Why Work at Nebraska Medicine?

  • Together. Extraordinary. Join a team that values your skills, delivering exceptional care through collaboration.
  • Leading Health Network Work with the region’s top academic health network, partnering with UNMC to transform lives through education, research, and patient care.
  • Dignity and Respect: We value all backgrounds and experiences, reflecting the communities we serve.
  • Educational Support Enjoy up to $5,000/year in tuition assistance, a 35% discount at Clarkson College, and career advancement opportunities with covered educational costs. Enjoy support for your personal growth within the organization, from those just starting their healthcare careers to those who are years down the path.

Be part of something extraordinary at Nebraska Medicine!

The Clinical Trials Applications Sr Analyst will analyze and translate workflow and documentation requirements for clinical and/or business processes into efficient and effective application systems solutions through collaboration with members of interprofessional care teams, operational leaders, technical team members, and other relevant stakeholders. Plan, design, develop, validate, test, implement, evaluate, maintain, and provide on-going troubleshooting and support of comprehensive information system components to meet needs and business requirements. Perform quality assurance and integrated testing of current and newly released vendor functionality to ensure system reliability. Coordinate projects across applications and develops application specific enhancements and reports in alignment with organizational priorities. Provide 24/7 support for applications within accountability.


Required Qualifications: Applications Sr Analyst - Clinical Trials

  • Minimum of four years' experience in designated area of application supported, to include direct experience with applications/systems and end-user support required.

  • High school education or equivalent required.

  • Bachelor's degree OR equivalent combination of education/experience combined (one year of education equals one year of experience) required.

  • If supporting an Epic application, the ability to obtain appropriate EPIC Certification with six months of hire required.

  • Based on department need, experience with core business ERP systems such as Oracle, Lawson and Workday required.

  • Proficient knowledge and ability to employ systems analysis and quality assurance concepts, techniques, industry best practices, tools and standard required.

  • Strong communication, interpersonal, and rapport-building skills required.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office applications required, specifically Outlook, Excel, and Power Point required.

  • Strong attention to detail and multi-tasking required.

  • Ability to translate an understanding of computer system capabilities to address user process requirements required.

  • Ability to exercise independent problem-solving skills and manage job priorities and projects in a self-directed manner

  • Analytical skills necessary to apply expertise to problems and/or increase operational efficiency with systems required.

  • Ability to analyze the functionality of systems and their fit within specifications required.

  • Based on department need, currently licensed as a Registered Nurse in the state of Nebraska or current compact state license or appropriate allied health license or registration in the state of Nebraska only as required in accordance with appropriate health-related degree required.


Preferred Qualifications: Applications Sr Analyst - Clinical Trials

  • Experience with workflow analysis or development of application solutions preferred.

  • Experience with specific business or clinical system used in job (e.g. Lawson, Omnicell, Workday, Oracle, etc.) preferred.

  • If supporting an Epic application, experience in Epic applications, other electronic health record applications, and/or healthcare operations background (e.g., clinical, billing, scheduling, access services, health information management, etc.) preferred.

  • Master's degree preferred.

  • Epic applications certification preferred. EPIC certification in designated application area(s) is strongly preferred.

  • Knowledge of clinical, business, and/or operational healthcare hospital/clinic workflows preferred.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Visio preferred. Strong project management and presentation skills preferred.

  • Professional level certification from an accredited organization in relevant informatics, health information technology, clinical or business specialties preferred.

Nebraska Medicine is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, marital status, sex, age, national origin, disability, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity and protected veterans’ status.

title: Inventory Specialist
description:
Want to help pets live their best lives?


We’re proud to be where the pets go and where the pet people go. If you want to make a real difference, create an exciting career path, feel welcome to be your whole self and nurture your wellbeing, Petco is the place for you.


Our core values capture that spirit as we work to improve lives by doing what’s right for pets and people.


  • Pet First – Protect & Empower. All pets should Live their Best Life. We put the needs of pets and pet parents at the center of everything we do.

  • Foster the Fun – Connect & Bond. Our Passion for pets brings us together! We celebrate the journey of pet parenthood through distinct experiences, products, and services.

  • Let’s Go! Own & Commit. We are stronger as One Petco team. We bring our unique superpowers and champion authenticity in everyone to drive success.

About Petco:


We’re proud to be "where the pets go" to find everything they need to live their best lives for more than 60 years — from their favorite meals and toys, to trusted supplies and expert support from people who get it, because we live it. We believe in the universal truths of pet parenthood — the boundless boops, missing slippers, late night zoomies and everything in between. And we’re here for it. Every tail wag, every vet visit, every step of the way. We are 29,000+ strong and together we nurture the pet-human bond in more than 1,500 Petco stores across the U.S., Mexico and Puerto Rico, 250+ Vetco Total Care hospitals, hundreds of preventive care clinics and eight distribution centers. In 1999, we founded Petco Love. Together, we support thousands of local animal welfare groups nationwide and have helped find homes for approximately 7 million animals through in-store adoption events.



As an Omni Specialist, you play a key role in delivering seamless, efficient omnichannel experiences that connect our customers to the products they need, when and how they want them.

With a primary focus on Ship-from-Store (SFS) and Omni Channel execution, you support daily operational excellence within the Pet Care Center (PCC). You ensure accurate picking, packing, shipping, and inventory flow while also supporting merchandise receiving, stocking, and customer service as needed. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys operational precision, teamwork, and problem-solving in a fast-paced environment.

What You’ll Do

Pet First

  • Support a safe, clean, and compliant Pet Care Center environment for pets, customers, and partners.
  • Adhere to and promote all safety, loss prevention, and operational procedures.
  • Escalate issues or concerns appropriately to the Leader on Duty.

Foster the Fun

  • Provide friendly, helpful, and solution-oriented customer service when supporting the sales floor.
  • Support customer interactions using Petco’s selling model as needed.
  • Contribute to a collaborative, inclusive team culture focused on shared success.

Let’s Go!

  • Execute daily Ship-from-Store (SFS) operations, including accurate picking, packing, labeling, and shipping.
  • Support efficient Omni Channel execution to reduce processing time through process familiarity and operational discipline.
  • Assist with receiving, unloading, and stocking merchandise and supplies in accordance with operational guidelines.
  • Maintain accurate inventory flow and support quarterly and annual physical inventory counts.
  • Complete Omni and SFS-related projects, including planogram sets, labeling, signage, fixture setup, RTV processing, and hazardous waste handling.
  • Analyze on-site conditions versus plan, identify variances, and recommend or implement corrective actions.
  • Coordinate with Pet Care Center and field partners to ensure fixturing, floor plans, stocking, and SFS equipment are executed to standard.
  • Communicate daily status updates to PCC leadership, including unfinished orders or required system corrections.
  • Perform routine housekeeping tasks to maintain a clean, organized, and professional backroom and sales floor.
  • Support special projects and additional operational tasks as assigned.

Key Responsibilities

Omni Channel & Operations

  • Ensure accurate, timely execution of SFS and Omni Channel processes.
  • Maintain operational standards across backroom and sales floor environments.
  • Support inventory accuracy, replenishment, and merchandise presentation.
  • Follow all policies, procedures, and safety standards.

Customer Experience

  • Process register transactions accurately and efficiently when supporting the sales floor.
  • Deliver a positive customer experience through professionalism and teamwork.

What Success Looks Like

  • High school diploma or GED required, or equivalent work experience.
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
  • Basic math proficiency and above-average communication skills.
  • Ability to follow processes while applying sound judgment when needed.
  • Strong teamwork and problem-solving skills.
  • Genuine interest in animals and their care preferred.

What You Bring

Experience & Skills

  • Minimum of 1 year of experience working with or caring for companion animals and aquatic life.
  • Strong knowledge of animal care, husbandry, and maintenance practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to educate others and communicate effectively.
  • Strong customer service mindset with an aptitude for selling behaviors.
  • Basic business, math, and inventory management skills.
  • Strong organizational, interpersonal, and communication skills.
  • High school diploma or GED preferred.
  • Completion and ongoing maintenance of the Petco Animal Care Certification Program required.

Essential Functions & Work Environment

This role is performed in a Pet Care Center retail environment and requires active engagement on the sales floor.

  • The role requires frequent standing and walking, as well as bending, kneeling, reaching, and lifting.
  • Ability to safely lift and move merchandise, supplies, or animals weighing up to 50 pounds.
  • Regular engagement with customers on the sales floor, including providing customer assistance and performing cashiering and point-of-sale transactions.
  • Must be able to work in proximity to animals, including exposure to animal dander, odors, noises, and cleaning chemicals.
  • Flexible availability to support Pet Care Center operating hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.

Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this role.

Why You’ll Love It Here

  • Purpose-driven work that makes a difference for pets and people.
  • A welcoming, inclusive team environment.
  • Opportunities to learn, grow, and explore career paths.
  • A fun, fast-paced role where no two days are the same.

title: Director of Customer Experience Programmes
description:
Darktrace is a global leader in AI-driven cybersecurity, helping organizations stay ahead of evolving threats every day.

Darktrace was built on a genuinely differentiated idea: that Adaptive AI could detect and respond to novel, real-time cyber threats. That approach matters more than ever in the era of AI. Today, our customers depend on us to stay ahead.

At Darktrace, we are energized by that responsibility. We work across teams and rally around a shared goal. We own outcomes end to end - step in, step up and see things through without waiting to be asked. We make decisions with urgency, say the hard thing, and hold each other to high standards with care and directness. We move first and learn fast anticipating where our customers are going next, continuously challenging ourselves.

We invest in the skills, learning and opportunities that help people deliver at the level their roles demand, and reward the aptitude and curiosity to grow beyond them.

Our Values: Own It | Win as One | Raise Our Bar | Move First. Learn Fast





Job Description:

The Director, CX Programmes drives the execution and day-to-day management of strategic and operational programmes that improve Darktrace’s ability to deliver customer outcomes effectively and efficiently at scale. Reporting to the VP of Customer Experience Programmes, this role translates CX strategy into structured, well-governed programmes and works cross-functionally with Customer Success, Sales, Product, Enablement, HR, and Operations to orchestrate results.

This role is the operational backbone of the CX Programmes function — building and optimising company-wide CX processes, developing lifecycle frameworks and playbooks, and managing the delivery of priority initiatives on behalf of the VP. The Senior Manager / Director acts as a trusted advisor to regional CX leaders, providing relevant and timely insights that inform their strategies, while ensuring cross-functional alignment on the programmes that matter most to customer retention and growth.

Core Responsibilities

1. Programme Execution & Governance

  • Translate the CX Programmes strategy into structured delivery plans with clear milestones, owners, dependencies, and timelines.

  • Drive end-to-end programme management for complex, cross-functional CX initiatives spanning Darktrace’s customer segments and global regions.

  • Build and maintain programme governance frameworks — status reporting, risk logs, steering committee materials, and executive updates.

  • Manage competing priorities across multiple workstreams, escalating decisions and trade-offs

2. CX Lifecycle Process & Playbook Development

  • Develop and operationalise scalable processes across the Darktrace customer lifecycle: Land, Onboard & Run, Renew & Expand.

  • Build CX playbooks in partnership with the VP and regional CX leaders, ensuring consistency across segments while allowing for local adaptation, covering onboarding, adoption, health management, value reviews, renewal readiness, and expansion.

  • Define engagement models and touch-point frameworks appropriate to each customer segment, working collaboratively with the Digital CX team where human-led and scaled motions intersect.

  • Curate and maintain process documentation, templates, and tooling to enable efficient and repeatable customer outcome delivery across the CX organisation.

3. Organisational Change & Transformation

  • Manage the operational delivery of large-scale CX transformation programmes, including role transitions, coverage model changes, and new capability buildouts across regions.

  • Partner with HR, Enablement, and regional CX leaders on change management execution, skills assessment, training design, communications planning, and phased rollout.

  • Build transition tracking, reporting, and risk management frameworks to keep programmes on track and stakeholders informed.

  • Coordinate with Darktrace’s Centre of Excellence (COE) and regional delivery teams on integration, process alignment, and operating model consistency.

4. Cross-Functional Alignment & Stakeholder Advisory

  • Act as a trusted advisor to regional CX leaders, providing relevant data, programme insights, and recommendations that help shape their segment strategies.

  • Drive cross-functional alignment between CX, Sales, Renewals, Product, and Enablement on shared programmes and customer engagement processes.

  • Coordinate with Product teams to bring the voice of the customer into roadmap discussions, informed by adoption data, health metrics, and customer feedback.

  • Support the VP in preparing executive-level materials for ExCo and leadership forums, including programme status, strategic recommendations, and investment cases.

5. Measurement, Reporting & Continuous Improvement

  • Build and maintain programme dashboards and reporting cadences for the VP, CX leadership, and the wider business.

  • Track and report on key CX metrics — GRR, NRR, adoption, customer health, renewal rates, and expansion — at the programme and segment level.

  • Use data to surface programme gaps and risks, providing recommendations to the VP to inform prioritisation and investment decisions.

  • Drive a culture of continuous improvement by bringing operational insights, benchmarks, and improvement opportunities to the leadership team.

What Success Looks Like

  • CX programmes are delivered on time, on scope, and with measurable impact on customer retention, adoption, and growth.

  • The VP has clear, reliable visibility into programme status, risks, and outcomes at all times.

  • Scalable lifecycle processes and playbooks are adopted across Darktrace’s customer segments and regions, driving consistency without sacrificing local relevance.

  • Regional CX leaders view the Programmes function as a trusted source of insight, structure, and operational support.

  • Cross-functional stakeholders (Sales, Product, Enablement, Renewals) see the Programmes team as well-run, reliable, and easy to work with.

  • The CX organisation can absorb change — new roles, new products, new coverage models — with minimal disruption to customers.

Key Skills & Experience

  • 7–10+ years of progressive experience in Customer Success Operations, Programme Management, or CX Strategy & Operations within a B2B SaaS or technology company.

  • Proven track record leading large-scale organisational change or transformation programmes (e.g., role transitions, operating model redesigns, process re-engineering).

  • Strong programme and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple complex, cross-functional workstreams simultaneously.

  • Experience building and optimising company-wide customer lifecycle processes (onboarding, adoption, health scoring, renewal, expansion) and codifying them into repeatable playbooks.

  • Demonstrated ability to act as a strategic advisor to senior leaders — translating data and operational insights into actionable recommendations.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills; comfortable presenting to and influencing senior leadership, including C-suite and ExCo.

  • Experience driving cross-functional programmes across Customer Success, Sales, Product, HR, and Enablement in organisations of 1,000+ employees.

  • Data-driven mindset with experience building dashboards, KPIs, and reporting frameworks for CX performance.

  • Experience in cybersecurity or a related technology domain is a plus.





Benefits:

  • 100% medical, dental and vision insurance, plus dependents

  • Paid parental leave

  • Pet insurance Discount

  • Life insurance

  • Commuter benefits

  • 401(k)

  • Employee Assistance Program





As a growing business strengthening its governance and controls, this role plays a part in supporting high standards of integrity and accountability.

title: Mecãnica II
description:
Descrição:

MECÂNICA II – MANUTENÇÃO – VARGEM GRANDE – VAGA EXCLUSIVA PARA MULHERES


Localidade: Nova Lima–MG, Brasil

Horário de Trabalho: Turno Diurno, 5x2, 7h00 às 16h30


Requisitos necessários:


• Ensino Médio completo.

• Curso profissionalizante de mecânica (SENAI ou equivalente).

• Experiência em manutenção industrial.

Requisitos desejáveis:


• CNH B ou D

• Formação técnica ou cursos específicos na área.

• Experiência mínima de 2 anos na área de britagem primária.


Responsabilidades e atividades do cargo:

﻿

• Realizar manutenções corretivas e preventivas;

• Executar serviços de montagem e revisão de componentes;

• Zelar pelas ferramentas de uso comum, máquinas de solda, conjunto de maçarico e acessórios;

• Atuar com foco em segurança, organização e trabalho em equipe;

• Executar serviços de manutenção corretiva, preventiva e inspeção eletromecânica em máquinas, equipamentos e instalações, componentes hidráulicos, pneumáticos, através de reparos ou substituição de peças, fazendo ajustes, regulagem e lubrificação;

• Auxiliar na montagem e desmontagem de peças e equipamentos;

• Interpretar desenhos, planos de manutenção, padrões e instruções de trabalho, entendendo o funcionamento dos componentes e seu inter-relacionamento no conjunto;

• Efetuar soldas utilizando arco elétrico com eletrodo revestido para pequenos reparos;

• Efetuar pequenos cortes utilizando oxicorte;

• Operar equipamentos auxiliares quando necessário como: furadeira de bancada e portátil, calandra, guilhotina, dobradeira, prensa hidráulica, lixadeira, estampadeira, esmeril, serra fita, máquina pantográfica, policorte, esmeriladeira, etc.

• Operar/ Manobrar quando necessário: ponte rolante, plataforma elevatória, empilhadeira, veículos automotores;

• Executar manutenções preventivas, corretivas e inspeção em sistemas automáticos de combate a incêndio de equipamentos;

• Executar serviços de inspeção básica em máquinas, e instalações;

• Controlar os serviços contratados de manutenção mecânica e de vulcanização mediante acompanhamento e fiscalização;

• Executar serviços de revestimento com borracha, reparos e fabricação de peças de borracha;

• Executar revisões de lubrificação dos equipamentos, subconjuntos e ou instalações;

• Manter e conservar as ferramentas necessárias para execução da atividade;

• Realizar troca de óleos lubrificantes e filtros;

• Realizar a coleta de amostras de lubrificantes para análise;

• Atualizar sistema informatizado de controle de manutenção;

• Executar limpeza / lavagem em peças e componentes, bem como nos equipamentos de mina e usina;

• Manter sua documentação de segurança e procedimentos aplicáveis atualizados.

title: Project Finance Associate II
description:
What We're Looking For

At HNTB, you can create a career that is meaningful to you while building communities that matter to all of us. For more than a century, we have been delivering solutions for some of the largest, most complex infrastructure projects across the country. With our historic growth, it is an exciting time to join our team of employee-owners.

This opportunity entails being responsible for maintaining project-related financial data in HNTB's project management system, ensuring alignment with current client contracts, including change orders, subconsultant agreements, and approved unauthorized work.

The Project Finance Associate supports the project finance team to ensure billing compliance with contractual documents. THIS IS AN IN OFFICE ROLE BASED OUT OF OUR TAMPA FL. OFFICE

title: Registered Dietitian
description:
Who We Are:

NEXDINE Hospitality’s family of brands provides dining, hospitality, fitness center and facility management services to businesses, independent schools, higher education, senior living, and hospitals nationwide. We put our people first to deliver finely tailored, expertly managed programs. The NEXDINE Experience is responsive, transparent, and authentic. Learn more at www.NEXDINE.com.

Job Details

Position: Registered Dietitian Nutritionist

Location: Rochester, NY

Schedule: 8-16 Hours per Week

Hours: Per Diem

Hourly Pay Rate: $41.00 - $45.00/hr

Pay Frequency: Weekly – Direct Deposit

What We Offer You:

  • Generous Compensation & Benefits Package

  • Health, Dental & Vision Insurance

  • Company-Paid Life Insurance

  • 401(k) Savings Plan

  • Paid Time Off: Vacation, Holiday, Sick Time

  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

  • Career Growth Opportunities

  • Various Employee Perks and Rewards

Job Summary:

The Registered Dietitian Nutritionist is a change agent within the Senior Living space for NEXDINE Hospitality, supporting You will be a part of a growing entrepreneurial organization that holds clinicians in high regard for their skillsets and expertise. Due to our scratch ingredient approach our philosophy is “food is medicine” therefore, we take a holistic approach with culinary and clinical integration within all operations. The Registered Dietitian Nutritionist will have the opportunity to impact seniors at this senior living community through implementation of innovative dining and nutrition related programming. The Registered Dietitian Nutritionist will be supporting one FTE at the Senior Living Facility.

Responsibilities:

  • Maintains and follows policies, standards and programs for the provision of optimal, cost-effective nutrition care to patients.

  • Develops goals and objectives for Clinical Nutrition to maintain high quality care.

  • Utilizes equipment, resources and programs to provide efficient and high quality care.

  • Assists in the performance planning process for Dietitians and Dietetic Interns and trains employees within the Food and Nutrition Services Department.

  • Establishes and maintains effective working relationships with other facility departments to provide a unified approach to patient care.

  • Establishes education programs for facility's professional staff (nursing, pharmacy, medical and surgical residents).

  • Develops, implements and documents in service education programs for Registered Dietitians, Dietitians, and Dietetic Interns and other nutrition personnel to provide continuing education and training.

  • May engage in and encourages staff to participate in research, submits to professional publications and professional and community lectures.

  • Maintains and establishes systems and training programs to provide a safe working environment. Complies with all OSHA regulations and other local, state and federal government regulations.

  • Maintains compliance with NEXDINE standards of operation and client contract. Maintains all records and reports necessary to comply with NEXDINE, government and accrediting agency standards, regulations and codes.

  • Maintains registration status through the Commission on Dietetic Registration and Licensure through the state board.

  • Maintains professional continuing education annually.

  • Maintains compliance with all requirements of Federal, State and local regulations and guidelines including the Civil Rights Act of 1964, as amended, the Age Discrimination in Employment Act of 1967, as amended, and the Americans with Disabilities Act, as amended.

Qualifications

Must be a Registered Dietitian.

Registration Requirements

  • Completed a minimum of a bachelor’s degree at a US regionally accredited university or college and course work accredited or approved by the Accreditation Council for Education in Nutrition and Dietetics (ACEND) of the Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics.

  • Completed an ACEND-accredited supervised practice program at a health-care facility, community agency, or a foodservice corporation or combined with undergraduate or graduate studies.

  • Pass a national examination administered by the Commission on Dietetic Registration (CDR).

  • Obtain / Maintain required state licensure to practice dietetics.

title: Field Service (Transfusion Service Ambassador)- Tempe, AZ
description:
Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 115,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

JOB DESCRIPTION:

About Abbott

Abbott is a global healthcare leader, creating breakthrough science to improve people’s health. We’re always looking towards the future, anticipating changes in medical science and technology.

Our diagnostic solutions are utilized in hospitals, laboratories, and clinics worldwide. The crucial information derived from our tests, instruments, and informatics systems is often the first step in patient care decision-making for hundreds of health conditions, ranging from heart attacks to blood disorders, infectious diseases, and cancers.

Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and family, be your true self, and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

  • Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.

  • Participants who complete a short wellness assessment qualify for FREE coverage in our HIP PPO medical plan. Free coverage applies in the next calendar year.

  • An excellent retirement savings plan with a high employer contribution.

  • Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program, and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree.

  • A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries around the world and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.

  • A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for, as well as the best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

The Opportunity

We have an opportunity for a Field Service Engineer (Transfusion Service Ambassador) to support our Transfusion Medicine Division.

  • This is a field-based remote position.

  • Qualified candidates must reside within 30 minutes of Tempe, AZ

  • Travel is required up to 75%.

What You’ll Work On

  • Serve as the primary on-site representative of Abbott Diagnostics Division (ADD), acting as a trusted partner to laboratory customers.

  • Own customer relationships with a focus on retention, customer loyalty, economic profitability, and value expansion.

  • Provide first-line technical support for complex diagnostic instruments, ensuring uptime, analytical turnaround time, and customer satisfaction.

  • Manage issue resolution end-to-end, escalating when necessary while maintaining ownership through closure.

  • Perform instrument installations, commissioning, preventive maintenance, upgrades, and troubleshooting.

  • Drive revenue growth through menu expansion, service sales, product promotion, and value-based solutions.

  • Conduct customer business reviews, KPI reviews, and structured customer visits (pre- and post-call planning).

  • Identify customer needs, training opportunities, operational pain points, and Voice of Customer (VOC) insights.

  • Coordinate order management, inventory control, consumables, contracts, and lifecycle management.

  • Ensure compliance with Abbott Quality Systems, CAPA requirements, regulatory standards, and safety guidelines.

  • Utilize CRM, service, and reporting systems to document activities, manage tickets, and track performance.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Technical Service, Customer Support, and Finance teams.

  • Support territory and district business objectives, including on-call coverage, travel, and mentoring of peers.

Key Measures of Success

  • Retention Rate

  • Net Promoter Score (NPS)

  • Cost of Service

  • Territory Sales and Growth Targets

  • Account Profitability Improvement

  • First-Line Service KPIs

Required Qualifications

  • Associate degree or an equivalent combination of education and work experience.

  • Minimum 2 years of experience supporting instrumentation used in a laboratory or blood bank environment.

  • Minimum 2 years of customer-facing experience providing technical, service, or operational support.

  • Ability to travel up to 75% and reside within 30 minutes of the Bedford, TX area.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Biomedical Engineering or a related engineering discipline.

  • 2 to 4 years of experience supporting laboratory instrumentation in a clinical laboratory, field service, or technical support environment.

  • Experience diagnosing and resolving hardware, software, or application issues using documented root-cause analysis.

  • Experience managing onsite support activities across multiple customer accounts or locations.

  • Experience completing instrument installations, preventive maintenance, upgrades, and commissioning activities.

  • Experience influencing product utilization, service adoption, or menu expansion through customer engagement.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint for reporting, documentation, and KPI tracking.

  • Experience using CRM, service management, or customer support systems to document and manage service activities.

* Participants who complete a short wellness assessment qualify for FREE coverage in our HIP PPO medical plan. Free coverage applies in the next calendar year.
