title: Survey Crew Chief
location: Idaho Falls, Idaho, United States; Twin Falls, Idaho, United States
description:
Civil Science is seeking an experienced Survey Crew Chief to join our growing Idaho survey team. This is an exciting opportunity for a skilled field professional who enjoys leading survey operations, solving problems in the field, and working on impactful infrastructure and transportation projects across eastern and southern Idaho.

As a Survey Crew Chief, you'll lead one- and two-person survey crews, perform construction staking, boundary, topographic, and design surveys, and work with cutting-edge Trimble technology to deliver accurate, high-quality survey data. You'll collaborate closely with project managers, engineers, contractors, and clients while helping deliver projects that shape the communities where we live and work.

This position can be based in Twin Falls or Idaho Falls, with travel throughout southeast Idaho and occasional trips to southwest Idaho.

What You'll Do

  • Lead field survey crews on transportation, infrastructure, and public works projects throughout Idaho.
  • Perform construction staking, boundary, topographic, and design surveys using Trimble GPS, robotic total stations, and other advanced survey equipment.
  • Collect, process, and verify accurate survey data while maintaining quality and safety standards.
  • Coordinate with project managers, engineers, contractors, and clients to support successful project delivery.
  • Mentor junior survey staff and contribute to continuous improvement of survey operations.

What You'll Bring

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional survey field experience.
  • Experience leading survey crews or independently managing field survey operations.
  • Proficiency with:
    • Trimble GPS equipment
    • Robotic Total Stations
    • Trimble Business Center
    • Civil 3D
    • Adobe Acrobat
  • Strong experience with:
    • Construction staking/layout
    • Boundary surveying
    • Topographic surveys
  • Excellent communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work outdoors in varying weather and travel as projects require.
  • Occasional Travel Required

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience performing ALTA surveys.
  • ITD design survey experience.
  • Associate degree in Surveying, Geomatics, or a related field (Bachelor's preferred).
  • Professional Land Surveyor (PLS) licensure is a plus but not required for this Crew Chief role.
  • Part 107 Drone Pilot License

Why Join Civil Science?

  • Ownership in Your Future: At Civil Science, we’re proud to be a 100% employee-owned firm. Through our Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP), you’ll have the chance to grow your career and save for retirement.

title: Site Reliability Engineering Intern
description:
About the job:

At Red Hat, our interns are an integral part of the team. They don’t get relegated to busywork or unimportant tasks, but participate in the day-to-day work and are active contributors to their team.

We are currently looking for a Site Reliability Engineering intern to join us in Pune, India. You will work closely with a senior mentor to gain technical knowledge and experience in your field, and cooperate with a broader international team both locally and globally.

In this role, you will work in an environment where different perspectives are invited, the best ideas are valued, and people feel empowered to contribute. Freedom and courage are two of our core values, which is why you can practice taking risks and exploring the unknown and developing strengths. Yet being a Red Hatter isn't just about being brave; it's also about demonstrating commitment and sticking to it.

What will you do?

  • Contribute code to increase the scalability and reliability of the service

  • Contribute to software tests and participate in peer review to increase the quality of our codebase

  • Actively participate in knowledge sharing and collaboration

  • Work within a small agile team to develop and improve SRE software, support your peers, plan and self-improve

  • Network with other talented interns in a workplace where you can be yourself and thrive

What will you bring?

  • Currently pursuing the final year of a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or an equivalent discipline

  • Working knowledge of written and spoken English

  • Basic knowledge and willingness to use Python, Golang or similar programming language

  • Basic knowledge of UNIX or Linux operating system

  • Basic understanding of public cloud technologies

  • Passion, curiosity, and desire to create new things and examine how things work internally

  • Willingness to learn and proactivity work as a part of a wider team

Red Hat will not be providing visa sponsorship for this position. Therefore, in order to be considered for this position, you must have the ability to work without a need for current or future visa sponsorship.

About Red Hat

Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.

Inclusion at Red Hat
Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.

Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)

title: Level A Technician
description:
OVERVIEW OF THE COMPANY

Fox TV Stations

FOX Television Stations owns and operates 29 full power broadcast television stations in the U.S. These include stations located in 14 of the top 15 largest designated market areas, or DMAs, and duopolies in 11 DMAs, including the three largest DMAs (New York, Los Angeles and Chicago). Of these stations, 18 are affiliated with the FOX Network. In addition to distributing sports, entertainment and syndicated content, our television stations collectively produce approximately 1,200 hours of local news every week. These stations leverage viewer, distributor and advertiser demand for the FOX Network’s national content.

JOB DESCRIPTION

KTTV Fox 11 is seeking a versatile, hands-on Transmitter and Studio Engineer to support both our primary broadcast transmitter facility atop Mt. Wilson and our West Los Angeles production studios.

This role is perfect for a technician with strong troubleshooting instincts who wants a diverse workday. You will split your time between maintaining cutting-edge television studio gear and taking ownership of our high-power transmission systems.

Key Responsibilities

Transmitter Operations (Mt. Wilson)

  • Primary Site Ownership: Manage the daily operation, routine calibrations, and emergency troubleshooting of our high-power solid-state/liquid-cooled transmitters and RF switchgear.

  • Infrastructure & Power: Monitor critical site support systems, including site-located IT systems, microwave and terrestrial signal transport systems, satellite downlinks, UPS and generator systems, and other site-located equipment.

  • Emergency Restoration: Respond to transmitter outages, which includes driving up to the Mt. Wilson site in various weather conditions to keep the station on the air.

  • Compliance: Ensure the transmitter site complies with FCC standards.

Studio & Control Room Maintenance (West LA)

  • Broadcast Equipment Repair: Install, configure, and troubleshoot studio cameras, robotic pedestal systems, production switchers, and audio consoles.

  • Signal Flow & Routing: Maintain the central router, master control systems, and terminal equipment to ensure flawless video and audio delivery.

  • Newsroom IT Support: Assist with the upkeep of newsroom computer systems, editing bays (NLEs), playout servers, and automation systems (like Sony ELC).

  • System Integration: Wire and integrate new equipment racks, patch bays, and IP-based broadcast gear as our studio technology evolves.

What We Are Looking For (Requirements)

  • Experience: 2–3 years of experience in electronics repair, studio AV setup, IT/networking, or military technical roles. (A technical degree or equivalent training is highly valued).

  • Technical Aptitude: A solid grasp of signal flow, electrical safety, and how to use basic tools (such as multimeters, oscilloscopes, and hand tools).

  • IT Knowledge: Basic IT/networking skills (IP addresses, subnets, switches, PC’s ).

  • Driving & Logistics: Must have a valid driver's license, a clean driving record, and the confidence to drive mountain roads in rain, fog, or light winter conditions.

  • Physical Demands: Ability to lift up to 50 lbs., climb ladders, and work comfortably behind equipment racks.

  • Availability: Ability to work a flexible schedule, including being on-call for emergency transmitter or critical studio outages during off-hours.

  • Cable Management: Experience with soldering, custom cable fabrication, and reading schematics.

Nice to Haves (But Not Required):

  • Any background in amateur (Ham) radio, telecommunications, or basic RF. Training will be available on the high power transmitter systems.

  • 2 Year degree (or higher) in a technical subject such as IT, Electronics, etc.

  • Experience with SMPTE 2110, compressed signal encoding/decoding, DANTE, NDI

title: Market Data Services Director
description:
“I can be myself at work.”

You are more than a job title. We want you to feel comfortable doing great work and bringing your best, authentic self to everything you do. We value your talents, traditions, and uniqueness—and we’re committed to fostering a strong sense of belonging in a respectful workplace.

We intentionally seek diverse perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds, investing in a culture designed to celebrate differences. We believe that belonging leads to better outcomes and a stronger community of associates united by our mission. At Capital, we live our core values every day: Integrity, Client Focus, Diverse Perspectives, Long-Term Thinking, and Community.

“I can influence my income.”

You want to feel recognized at work. Your performance will be reviewed annually, and your compensation will be designed to motivate and reward the value that you provide. You’ll receive a competitive salary, bonuses and benefits. Your company-funded retirement contribution will factor in salary and variable pay, including bonuses.

“I can lead a full life.”

You bring unique goals and interests to your job and your life. Whether you’re raising a family, you’re passionate about where you volunteer, or you want to explore different career paths, we’ll give you the resources that can set you up for success.

  • Enjoy generous time-away and health benefits from day one, with the opportunity for flexible work options

  • Receive 2-for-1 matching gifts for your charitable contributions and the opportunity to secure annual grants for the organizations you love

  • Access on-demand professional development resources that allow you to hone existing skills and learn new ones

“I can succeed as the Market Data Services Director at Capital Group.”

As Capital Group continues to strengthen enterprise capabilities, we are investing in leadership roles that build scalable, high-performing operations across sourcing, procurement, and third-party management. The Enterprise Sourcing Office (ESO) is central to this effort, evolving how we manage demand, suppliers, and external spend. This is an opportunity to lead a critical Sourcing function and shape how ESO delivers consistent, high-quality outcomes. The Market Data Services Director will transform how we manage Market Data categories to amplify investment outcomes and firm-wide priorities. This is an opportunity to lead at scale, shaping strategy, influencing enterprise decisions, and driving measurable value across the Market Data ecosystem.

As a Director within ESO, you will lead the global strategy and delivery of the Market Data Services categories, including real-time and reference data that support investment decision-making and risk analysis, with accountability for category strategy, vendor management, and sourcing service delivery across an enterprise-wide portfolio.

You will develop and implement coordinated Market Data Services (MDS) category strategies aligned to enterprise priorities, balancing cost, risk, and quality, and directing the evaluation of data and research providers, platforms, data infrastructure, and services based on usage, market dynamics, and strategic value.

You will provide leadership for the most complex and high-impact supplier engagements, including strategic partnerships with key data providers, guiding negotiations, shaping commercial strategies, and strengthening supplier performance through structured engagement and governance, while ensuring alignment with relevant licensing and risk considerations.

You will serve as a strategic partner to senior business leaders, influencing how Market Data Services are sourced and optimized across the firm, while challenging demand, managing significant market data budgets, building financial insights into consumption patterns, and applying those insights to optimize cost, value, and overall spend. You will partner across business groups to ensure aligned and effective engagement with strategic suppliers, contributing to a coordinated approach in how Capital Group manages key supplier relationships.

You will direct the evolution of an integrated service delivery and supplier engagement model across MDS, ensuring scalable operations while enhancing platform, data, and workflow capabilities and building leadership capability and high-performing teams.

“I am the person Capital Group is looking for.”

  • You bring extensive experience leading Market Data categories, sourcing, and supplier management organizations, with a strong track record of developing and implementing enterprise-level strategies and leading change.

  • You have led complex supplier negotiations and managed strategic supplier relationships, including engagements with significant financial and operational impact.

  • You are effective at partnering with senior business leaders, influencing decisions, and aligning sourcing strategies to broader enterprise priorities.

  • You are an experienced people leader who builds strong teams, develops leadership capability, and creates an environment where individuals can perform at a high level and grow.

  • You bring a strategic and commercial mindset, with the ability to assess market conditions, evolve sourcing approaches, and drive long-term value across the supplier base.

  • You have a demonstrated ability to develop and implement sourcing and supplier strategies that align with enterprise priorities and business needs.

  • You have experience leading complex, high-value negotiations and managing strategic supplier relationships at scale.

  • You have a strong understanding of research platforms, data services, supplier lifecycle management, and third-party risk and governance practice, and market licensing and usage considerations.

  • You have a proven ability to partner with senior stakeholders to influence demand, sourcing decisions, and third-party cost optimization.

  • You have strong leadership capability, with experience building and developing high-performing, multi-level teams.

  • You have a deep understanding of sourcing disciplines, including RFP/RFI processes, contract negotiation, supplier lifecycle management, and risk mitigation.

  • You have strong communication skills, with the ability to engage and influence stakeholders and present effectively at executive levels.

  • You have proficiency with sourcing tools, data analysis, and technologies that support sourcing real-time and reference data delivering, reporting, and decision-making.

That’s why we offer a culture, compensation and opportunities that empower our associates to build successful and prosperous careers. title: Guest Service Representative/Reservations Agent - The Wickaninnish Inn
description:
Join our Front Office Team as a Guest Service Representative/Reservations Agent, where you have the opportunity to learn and grow in a Relais & Châteaux property recognized by Forbes, Michelin Key, AAA Four Diamond, and Travel & Leisure’s World’s Best Hotels.

We are dedicated to fostering a culture of belonging where every individual is appreciated and valued for who they are. We are passionate about providing a supportive environment for our team, delivering excellence to our guests while achieving the highest sustainability practices, and creating a lasting legacy for our families and communities.

A Guest Service Representative (GSR) is the Wickaninnish Inn’s version of a Front Desk Agent, and then some. The GSR not only greets guests and checks them in but they also become that guest’s personal contact throughout their stay. The position offers a great deal of flexibility to "think outside of the box" and positively impact guests’ experience. A GSR often has the opportunity to speak with a guest on the phone, make their reservation arrangements, and be the one to greet and check them in upon arrival and bring them to their room to get them settled in!

The Reservations Agent works alongside the Reservations Supervisor to be the primary contacts for all room reservations for the Wickaninnish Inn.

As a Guest Service Representative/Reservations Agent you will:

  • Ensure efficient and personalized guest service, meeting and exceeding Relais & Chateaux, AAA 4 & 5 Diamond, and Forbes Standards.
  • Take and process reservation calls.
  • Monitor and respond to all email inquiries.
  • Manage the day-to-day flow of online bookings.
  • Facilitate group rooming list entry.
  • Conduct ongoing checks for accuracy and guest confirmations.
  • Conduct clerical duties such as maintenance of reservations files and day-to-day operational paperwork.
  • Assist in the capacity of a Night Auditor whenever necessary.
  • Conduct daily administration tasks such as filing and faxing.
  • Welcome guests, check in and check out guests.
  • Facilitate guest orientation.
  • Deliver amenities (fruit plates, room deliveries, etc.).
  • Answer inquiries regarding the Inn’s services and registration by telephone, email, written correspondence, and in person.
  • Complete Guest Service and Concierge-related tasks.

The Wickaninnish Inn is committed to the principles of equality and diversity in the workplace. We aim to hire the best candidate for the position based on their qualifications and merit in terms of knowledge, skills, and experience.

Our ideal candidate will embody the West Coast culture while being committed to the art of hospitality and pursuit of excellence. They will have:

  • The willingness to learn in a team environment while striving to exceed Relais & Chateaux, AAA 4 & 5 Diamond, and Forbes Standards.
  • Exemplary guest service skills and a demonstrated willingness to exceed guest expectations.

title: Junior Groomer
description:
Want to help pets live their best lives?


We’re proud to be where the pets go and where the pet people go. If you want to make a real difference, create an exciting career path, feel welcome to be your whole self and nurture your wellbeing, Petco is the place for you.


Our core values capture that spirit as we work to improve lives by doing what’s right for pets and people.


  • Pet First – Protect & Empower. All pets should Live their Best Life. We put the needs of pets and pet parents at the center of everything we do.

  • Foster the Fun – Connect & Bond. Our Passion for pets brings us together! We celebrate the journey of pet parenthood through distinct experiences, products, and services.

  • Let’s Go! Own & Commit. We are stronger as One Petco team. We bring our unique superpowers and champion authenticity in everyone to drive success.

About Petco:


We’re proud to be "where the pets go" to find everything they need to live their best lives for more than 60 years — from their favorite meals and toys, to trusted supplies and expert support from people who get it, because we live it. We believe in the universal truths of pet parenthood — the boundless boops, missing slippers, late night zoomies and everything in between. And we’re here for it. Every tail wag, every vet visit, every step of the way. We are 29,000+ strong and together we nurture the pet-human bond in more than 1,500 Petco stores across the U.S., Mexico and Puerto Rico, 250+ Vetco Total Care hospitals, hundreds of preventive care clinics and eight distribution centers. In 1999, we founded Petco Love. Together, we support thousands of local animal welfare groups nationwide and have helped find homes for approximately 7 million animals through in-store adoption events.



Your Petco Grooming Career:

Begin your Petco journey as a Junior Pet Stylist in Grooming!

During this ten-week training period as a Junior Pet Stylist, you will learn fundamental grooming tasks such as brushing, bathing, drying, cutting nails, and more! Gaining hands-on experience with guidance from seasoned groomers, our industry leading program is designed to develop essential grooming skills and set the foundation for your future career with Petco Grooming.

In addition to our commitment to continuous training, development, and career growth, we also offer:

  • Competitive base pay
  • Medical, dental, vision and more
  • 401k and more
  • Paid Time Off
  • Petco Discounts
  • All the supplies & equipment you need, including, brushes, nail trimmers, clippers, blades, shampoo, sprays, tools, etc.
  • State of the art equipment, including bathing system, kennels, tables, and dryers

Purpose:

The Junior Pet Stylist's primary purpose is to learn how to perform the following services: bathing, drying, brushing, nail trimming, ear cleaning, and gland cleaning, alongside seasoned groomers. In addition to bathing and drying services, the Junior Pet Stylist will assist in the grooming process, prioritizing the comfort, safety, and well-being of the pets in our care and delivering optimal customer services to pet parents. This is an excellent opportunity for those passionate about animals and grooming to start their career in the pet care industry.

Essential Job Functions:

The incumbent must be able to consistently perform all the following duties and responsibilities with or without reasonable accommodation.

  • Under close supervision of experienced groomers, perform limited grooming services including bathing, drying, nail trimming, brushing, ear cleaning, and gland cleaning according to the pet parents’ instructions and in adherence to company policies and procedures
  • Ensure the well-being and safety of every animal in the salon at all times
  • Interact professionally and effectively with pet parents, provide optimal customer service, address grooming related inquiries and provide timely resolution
  • Maintain a clean and safe grooming area and salon, disinfect and sanitize grooming tools and equipment, perform daily and weekly cleaning duties in the salon and in adherence to Petco hygiene and sanitation policies, other cleaning and maintenance tasks as assigned, including but not limited to cleaning air filters, vents, and drains
  • Schedule grooming appointments, manage paperwork, and maintain accurate grooming records
  • Learn and adhere to Petco's grooming policies, standards, and guidelines to ensure safety, quality, and consistency in all activities and areas of the grooming business

Training Program Outline:

  • Weeks 1-3: Learning and On-the-Job Training
    • Learn dog behavior, pet and self-safety, proper check-in/out procedures, customer service, grooming policies, and begin on-the-job training in bathing and drying techniques
  • Weeks 3-10: Performing and Achieving Productivity
    • Perform bathing and walk-in services while achieving weekly productivity goals

Education/Experience:

  • 0-1 year of animal related experience, including shelter volunteering or pet sitting, prior grooming salon assistance is preferred
  • High-school diploma or GED is preferred, though not required
  • Genuine passion for animals and a desire to pursue a career in pet grooming
  • Basic understanding of dog breeds, behavior, and common grooming practices
  • Capable of handling pets of all sizes and temperaments with care and empathy
  • Effective verbal and written communication skills for interactions with pet parents and grooming team members
  • Availability to work weekends, evenings, and holidays, as required by the Pet Care Center’s grooming schedule

Work Environment:

The majority of job duties are conducted indoors in the grooming salon. Position requires bending, kneeling, lifting (up to 30 pounds, as necessary) and standing for long periods of time. Position may require exposure to heights using a two-step ladder or other support tools, such as vacuums, to perform assigned cleaning and maintenance duties. A large amount of this partner’s time will be spent in direct contact with our pet parents and their dogs, and the remaining time will be with the other salon partners. The work environment can be noisy and wet.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, protected veteran status, or any other protected classification.

Our 115,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries.

Microbiology Lab Supervisor

Working at Abbott

At Abbott, you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

  • Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.

The Opportunity

This position works out of our Altavista, VA location in the Abbott Nutrition division. Our Nutrition business develops science-based nutrition products for people of all ages, from helping babies and children grow to keeping adult bodies strong and active. Millions of people around the world count on our leading brands – including Similac®, PediaSure®, Pedialyte®, Ensure®, and Glucerna® – to help them get the nutrients they need to live their healthiest lives.

Altavista, Va., is one of Abbott’s largest nutrition manufacturing plants equipped with advanced technology to ensure efficient production. Working here will make you feel like you’re part of a family that works together to make a difference and help nourish millions of families around the world.

The Microbiology Front Line Leader supervises the activities and resources within the Microbiology Laboratory area to ensure support is provided to meet the department and company goals. Lead the team of technicians who perform the microbiology testing. Manage the operation of microbiology laboratory including developing and implementing microbiology testing: sterility testing, environmental testing (air, surface, fluid, bioburden), bacteria ID, certification of the population of the label claim and new types of biological testing as necessary.

What You’ll Work On

  • Responsible for compliance with applicable Corporate and Divisional Policies and procedures.

  • Supervises microbiology testing including biological indicator incubation time studies.

  • Manages the working schedule within the Microbiology Laboratory.

  • Writes protocols and reports (sterilization, bioburden recovery, ETO dissipation etc.).

  • Determines new test methods as appropriate.

  • Monitors equipment performance and calibration schedules.

  • Creates laboratory operation procedures and follows guidelines from regulatory agencies

  • Drive a culture of engagement through the team and department. Directly supervises team and participates in staffing activities. Develop all line personnel by securing appropriate training, providing mentoring and assigning progressively challenging stretch responsibilities within the scope of the team and department accountabilities.

  • Manage budget accountability for Headcount, Overtime, and direct expenses for a shift and/or line. Track, trend and continuously improve budgetary performance for direct expenses, headcount, overtime (OT), Material Usage Variance (MUV) and Scrap and Cost Improvement Projects (CIP).

  • Understand performance drivers and develop and execute plans around improvement of line performance and quality metrics with support from the direct manager. Understand all key performance indicators, driving and executing plans for improvement through team engagement.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and work experience.

  • 2-5 years of related work experience with a good understanding of specified functional area.

  • Working technical knowledge and application of concepts, practices, and procedures.

  • Works on problems of moderate scope where analysis of situations or data requires a review of identifiable factors.

  • Exercises judgment within defined procedures and practices to determine appropriate action.

  • Has a broad knowledge of technical alternatives and an understanding of their impact on the systems environment

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s Degree with 0-2 years of related work experience

Apply Now

title: Borsa Italiana - Debt&Fund internship
description:
Are you ready to shape the future of capital markets? We are looking for a Debt and Fund Listing Intern to join the Debt and Fund Listing Team. The position will be based in Milan, and start in November.

You will primarily be responsible for:

  • Supporting the team in sales and business development activities for bonds and open-end funds, with a focus on client engagement and relationship building
  • Conducting company analysis and preparing presentations (PowerPoint) that highlight how Euronext can address client needs, including tailored solutions
  • Monitoring regulatory aspects and providing introductory analysis, including competitor benchmarking and regulatory analysis
  • Assisting in the preparation of marketing materials and communication initiatives (brochures, website, promotional videos, launch events, social media, especially LinkedIn)
  • Preparing speeches and materials for third-party events and conferences, with a focus on ESG topics and issuer engagement
  • Supporting CRM activities and helping to expand the issuer network

Your profile:

  • Master’s degree (or ongoing) in Economics, Finance or Business Administration
  • Strong knowledge of financial markets, corporate finance and market analysis (trading experience not required)
  • Excellent communication skills, sociable and comfortable in networking situations
  • Creative and original approach, with a keen interest in digital communication and social media
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel)
  • Fluency in both spoken and written English
  • Team player, proactive, curious and organised, with strong analytical skills
  • Flexible and eager to learn in a dynamic environment

Join a company where market infrastructure is built on innovation — and where every innovation starts with a bold mind asking, “What’s next?”. At Euronext, we believe change is a starting point, not an obstacle. We look for people who see growth opportunities, think long term, and want to help shape capital markets for future generations. Working with us means:

  • Being part of a European, international and diverse team – Collaborate across borders with talented colleagues connected by a shared ambition and purpose.
  • Learning as you grow – Develop your skills through continuous learning, real responsibilities and flexible career paths that evolve with you.
  • Having an impact – Contribute to projects that matter, in an agile and dynamic environment where your ideas help drive progress.
  • Driving sustainability – Play an active role in building transparent, responsible and sustainable capital markets for the long term. Together, we do not just support markets – we help shape their future.

Apply by submitting a CV in Italian or English.

The Debt and Fund Listing Team’s mission is to connect ambitious companies with the capital they need to grow. We work closely with businesses considering a bond or fund listing and support issuers throughout their journey on our markets. Our team champions the advantages of listing, guiding business leaders through every step and ensuring they make the most of public markets. We drive innovation by developing new services and financing instruments, helping companies access diverse funding opportunities. By nurturing relationships with a broad pool of investors, we contribute to the vibrancy and growth of our markets. We also play a key role in promoting transparency and trust, working with financial industry stakeholders and public authorities to uphold the highest standards.

Join Euronext – Shape capital markets for future generations
Euronext is the leading European capital market covering the entire capital markets value chain, from listing, trading, clearing, settlement and custody, to solutions for issuers and investors. We operate seven national stock exchanges, handling 25% of European lit equity trading. Our products include equities, FX, ETFs, bonds, derivatives, commodities and indices. Euronext also provides clearing and settlement services through Euronext Clearing and our network of Euronext Securities CSDs. In addition, Euronext runs MTS, one of Europe’s leading electronic fixed income trading markets, and Nord Pool, the European power market. The company has a diverse domestic and international client base.
Find out more about us at: Euronext.com

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate against individuals on the basis of race, gender, age, citizenship, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, or any other legally protected factor. We value the unique talents of all our people, who come from diverse backgrounds with different personal experiences and points of view and we are committed to providing an environment of mutual respect.

title: Operations Leader
description:
Want to help pets live their best lives?


We’re proud to be where the pets go and where the pet people go. If you want to make a real difference, create an exciting career path, feel welcome to be your whole self and nurture your wellbeing, Petco is the place for you.


Our core values capture that spirit as we work to improve lives by doing what’s right for pets and people.


  • Pet First – Protect & Empower. All pets should Live their Best Life. We put the needs of pets and pet parents at the center of everything we do.

  • Foster the Fun – Connect & Bond. Our Passion for pets brings us together! We celebrate the journey of pet parenthood through distinct experiences, products, and services.

  • Let’s Go! Own & Commit. We are stronger as One Petco team. We bring our unique superpowers and champion authenticity in everyone to drive success.

About Petco:


We’re proud to be "where the pets go" to find everything they need to live their best lives for more than 60 years — from their favorite meals and toys, to trusted supplies and expert support from people who get it, because we live it. We believe in the universal truths of pet parenthood — the boundless boops, missing slippers, late night zoomies and everything in between. And we’re here for it. Every tail wag, every vet visit, every step of the way. We are 29,000+ strong and together we nurture the pet-human bond in more than 1,500 Petco stores across the U.S., Mexico and Puerto Rico, 250+ Vetco Total Care hospitals, hundreds of preventive care clinics and eight distribution centers. In 1999, we founded Petco Love. Together, we support thousands of local animal welfare groups nationwide and have helped find homes for approximately 7 million animals through in-store adoption events.



As a Key Holder, you are a trusted member of the leadership team who helps ensure smooth daily operations, exceptional customer service, and a safe, secure environment for pets, partners, and customers.

You support store leadership by supervising partners, opening and closing the store, and serving as a point of contact when management is not present. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys leading on the floor, solving problems in the moment, and delivering a great experience every day.

What You’ll Do

Pet First

  • Uphold Petco’s animal care standards, ensuring the health, safety, and proper handling of all animals.
  • Promote a safe, welcoming environment for pets, pet parents, and partners.
  • Follow all policies and procedures related to animal welfare, safety, and store operations.

Foster the Fun

  • Deliver friendly, knowledgeable, and solution-oriented service to every customer.
  • Support and supervise store partners, helping maintain productivity and positive morale.
  • Assist with training new partners and reinforcing best practices on the sales floor.
  • Help maintain a clean, organized, and visually appealing store environment.

Let’s Go!

  • Open and close the store while following all cash handling, safety, and security protocols.
  • Support daily store operations including sales, task execution, and recovery.
  • Execute merchandising standards, including planograms, pricing accuracy, signage, and promotional set-ups.
  • Assist with inventory activities such as restocking, cycle counts, inventory integrity, and required inventory paperwork.
  • Identify out-of-stocks, low inventory, or merchandising issues and communicate them to store leadership.
  • Process transactions, refunds, and exchanges accurately and efficiently.
  • Act as the primary point of contact in the absence of store management.
  • Support sales initiatives and promotions to help achieve store goals.

Key Responsibilities

Store Operations, Merchandising & Inventory

  • Maintain merchandise presentation and in-stock conditions to Petco standards.
  • Ensure accurate pricing and signage throughout the store.
  • Assist with inventory counts, product replenishment, and shrink awareness.
  • Monitor merchandising and inventory conditions during shifts and escalate issues as needed.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and safety standards.

Customer Experience & Leadership

  • Address customer questions and resolve concerns promptly and professionally.
  • Model Petco’s selling behaviors and service expectations.
  • Provide guidance and direction to partners during assigned shifts.
  • Escalate concerns appropriately to store leadership.

What Success Looks Like

  • The store opens and closes safely and smoothly.
  • Merchandise is well-stocked, accurately priced, and visually appealing.
  • Inventory is handled accurately and with care.
  • Customers receive prompt, friendly, and knowledgeable service.
  • Partners feel supported and clear on expectations during each shift.

What You Bring

Experience & Skills

  • Previous retail experience required; key holder or supervisory experience preferred.
  • Strong leadership, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
  • Ability to multitask and thrive in a fast-paced environment.
  • Basic math skills and experience handling cash and transactions.
  • Reliable, responsible, and detail oriented.

Essential Functions & Work Environment

This role is primarily performed in a Pet Care Center retail environment. The Key Holder is expected to be regularly present on the sales floor, leading by example and engaging with partners, customers, and pets.

  • Majority of work is conducted indoors; however, occasional duties may require leaving the Pet Care Center for tasks such as bank deposits, merchandise transport, or community events.
  • The role requires frequent standing and walking, as well as bending, kneeling, reaching, and lifting.
  • Ability to safely lift and move merchandise, supplies, or animals weighing up to 50 pounds.
  • Regular engagement with customers on the sales floor, including providing customer assistance and performing cashiering and point-of-sale transactions.
  • Must be able to work in proximity to animals, including exposure to animal dander, odors, noises, and cleaning chemicals.
  • Flexible availability to support Pet Care Center operating hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
  • A limited amount of travel may be required for training, meetings, or community engagement.

Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this role.

Why You’ll Love It Here

  • Purpose-driven work that makes a difference for pets and people.
  • Opportunities to build leadership skills and grow your career.
  • A collaborative, inclusive team culture.
  • A strong stepping stone for future leadership opportunities.

*this is a hybrid position (remote and in-office)

Job Summary:

The Instructional Designer creates engaging, effective learning experiences that builds employee capability and supports business goals. This role partners with subject matter experts, facilitators, HR, and business leaders to design instructor-led, virtual, blended, and self-paced learning solutions rooted in adult learning principles.

Responsibilities:

  • Designs and develops learning experiences, curriculum, assessments, facilitator guides, job aids, and performance support tools.

  • Creates role-based learning paths and structured learning journeys aligned to business needs.

  • Partners with SMEs, facilitators, HR, and business leaders to identify learning needs, define objectives, and measure success.

  • Leads content planning, review, and revision cycles to ensure learning materials are accurate, relevant, and scalable.

  • Incorporates interactive and experiential learning strategies to improve engagement, retention, and on-the-job application.

  • Evaluates learner feedback, assessment results, and business needs to continuously improve programs.

  • Supports learning technology, LMS content, completion tracking, and digital course maintenance in partnership with the L&D team.

  • Uses authoring tools, multimedia, AI, and emerging technologies to enhance learning experiences.

  • Provides stakeholder support, training, and troubleshooting for learning tools and processes.

  • Supports in-person learning experiences as needed, including observing facilitation and assisting with learner experience logistics.

  • Performs other duties as assigned by manager.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Instructional Design, Learning & Development, HR, Organizational Development, Education, or a related field.

  • At least 2 years of experience designing and developing learning solutions in a corporate, educational, or training environment.

  • Strong knowledge of adult learning theory, instructional design methods, and learning evaluation practices.

  • Experience designing instructor-led, virtual, blended, and self-paced programs.

  • Strong project management, organization, communication, and stakeholder collaboration skills.

  • Experience developing assessments, learner activities, facilitator guides, job aids, and other learning resources.

  • Ability to travel occasionally, currently estimated at less than 20%.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Certification in Instructional Design, Learning Experience Design, Talent Development, or related field.

  • Experience with tools such as Articulate Storyline, Rise, Vyond, Camtasia, Canva, Adobe Acrobat, and Microsoft 365.

  • Experience with Workday Learning or another LMS.

THE OPPORTUNITY

This Senior Release Engineer​ position works onsite in our Alameda, CA location for Lingo.

As a Senior Release Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the reliable, secure, and efficient delivery of software releases across Lingo's mobile applications, backend services, and cloud platforms. You will lead end-to-end release planning and execution, partnering with Engineering, Cloud Infrastructure, QARA, Product Management, and Program Management teams to drive deployment readiness, release governance, and continuous process improvement.

In this role, you will oversee release coordination across multiple teams and technologies, helping to deliver high-quality software while minimizing risk and maintaining compliance with established standards. You will also be responsible for mobile application release management, including app store submissions and publication activities for the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with operational excellence, project leadership, and effective cross-functional collaboration. This is an opportunity to influence release strategy, advance CI/CD and automation capabilities, improve engineering efficiency, and contribute to the delivery of innovative digital health solutions that positively impact customers worldwide.

What You'll Work On

  • Plan, coordinate, and execute software releases across website, mobile applications, backend services, data platform and cloud platforms.

  • Track release activities, milestones, dependencies and action items to ensure on-time and high-quality delivery.

  • Establish and maintain release records and audit-ready documentation to support compliance, traceability and operational excellence.

  • Partner with engineering and QA teams to validate release readiness, quality gates, test completion, security reviews, and rollback procedures.

  • Manage release dependencies, risks, deployment communications, and stakeholder expectations across multiple teams and environments.

  • Coordinate mobile application release activities, including App Store and Google Play submissions, release scheduling, compliance reviews, phased rollouts, production approvals, and post-release monitoring.

  • Manage end-to-end app submission processes, ensuring releases meet Apple App Store and Google Play requirements, policies, and publishing timelines.

  • Support and optimize CI/CD pipelines to improve deployment reliability, efficiency, and release velocity.

  • Partner with DevOps and platform teams to automate release processes and reduce manual deployment activities.

  • Monitor production deployments and coordinate issue triage, incident management, and rollback activities when necessary.

  • Ensure releases meet security, compliance, performance, and operational readiness standards.

  • Analyze release outcomes, track deployment metrics, and drive continuous improvements to release processes, tooling, and governance.

  • Collaborate with Product and Program Management teams to align release cadence with business priorities and roadmap milestones.

  • Provide technical leadership and guidance on release engineering best practices across distributed engineering teams.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • 5+ years of experience in Release Engineering, Release Management, DevOps, Software Delivery, or related technical roles.

  • Strong understanding of Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), Agile methodologies, and release management best practices.

  • Experience managing releases in cloud-native, SaaS, mobile, or distributed software environments.

  • Hands-on experience with CI/CD platforms such as Harness, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar tools.

  • Experience with deployment automation, environment management, and release orchestration.

  • Hands-on experience managing mobile application releases and submissions to the Apple App Store and Google Play Store.

  • Strong understanding of App Store Connect, Google Play Console, app review processes, provisioning profiles, signing certificates, release approvals, phased rollouts, and mobile deployment best practices.

  • Strong documentation skills with experience creating and maintaining release notes, deployment plans, runbooks, change records and operational support documentation.

  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and coordinate activities across globally distributed teams.

  • Excellent verbal, written, and stakeholder communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting regulated environments such as healthcare, medical devices or life sciences.

  • Experience implementing DevOps, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), and continuous delivery practices.

  • Knowledge of change management, production support, and incident management processes.

  • Experience supporting global mobile application launches and coordinating app store releases across multiple regions.

  • Familiarity with TestFlight, Firebase App Distribution, mobile release automation tools, and beta testing frameworks.

  • Experience leading release activities across multiple products, teams, vendors, and geographic regions.

title: NVH Product Engineer (M/F/D)
description:
Role Purpose

The NVH Product Engineer is responsible for the product-side ownership of NVH performance on the assigned programme(s) covering root-cause analysis, design countermeasures, customer interface and feedback loop into CAE / ETC.

The role reports hierarchically to the NVH Supervisor and works in matrix with Product Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Testing, Quality, CAE / ETC and Global product owners. The Product Engineer is the technical authority on NVH product behaviour for the assigned scope, complementary to the NVH Testing Coordinator who owns the testing side.

Key Responsibilities

Product NVH Ownership

  • Owns NVH product performance for the assigned programme
  • Drives root-cause analysis on NVH defects and abnormal patterns
  • Defines and validates design countermeasures together with CAE, ETC and Global product owners.
  • Owns NVH parameters at EOL (limits, masks, retest rules) for the assigned product scope.

Customer Interface

  • Acts as plant technical interface to Customers on NVH product topics.
  • Prepares and delivers technical content for customer reviews, task forces and audits.
  • Translates customer NVH requirements into product validation and EOL acceptance criteria.

Cross-functional Alignment

  • Aligns daily with the NVH Testing Coordinator on test execution, retest decisions and data interpretation.
  • Drives design / process change requests through Product Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality.
  • Coordinates with the NVH Equipment Engineer to ensure measurement chain integrity.

Validation & Launch

  • Owns NVH validation activities for design changes (DV, PV, MR, PPAP) on the assigned programme.
  • Supports launch readiness and SOP gates from an NVH product perspective.
  • Drives lessons learned across HRAM, DL and AL programmes.

Knowledge & Methodology

  • Maintains the technical baseline for the assigned product scope — order analysis maps, MSA, spectrum interpretation rules.
  • Contributes to DFMEA / PFMEA NVH content.
  • Mentors NVH Product Technicians on root-cause and validation work.

Requirements & Competencies

Education & Experience

  • Engineering degree in Mechanical, Mechatronics or similar discipline (Master’s preferred).
  • Minimum 4–6 years of experience in NVH on automotive e-Drive, transmission or powertrain products.
  • Experience interfacing directly with customers on NVH topics is a strong advantage.

Technical Profile

  • Strong NVH fundamentals — order analysis, modal behaviour, gear and electric machine NVH, structure-borne vs. air-borne paths.
  • Hands-on experience with EOL NVH measurement chain and post-processing tools (Discom, ARTeMiS or similar).
  • Solid grasp of MSA, statistical methods and spectrum interpretation.
  • Knowledge of CAE/CAA tools and ability to engage with simulation teams (CAE / ETC).
  • Familiarity with FMEA methodology (AIAG/VDA).

Leadership & Behavioral Skills

  • Technical authority — able to defend product NVH positions internally and with customers.
  • Structured, fact-based problem solving under launch / crisis pressure.
  • Strong communication skills — technical, managerial and customer-facing.
  • Fluency in English mandatory; Portuguese strongly preferred.

title: Operations Leader
description:
Want to help pets live their best lives?


We’re proud to be where the pets go and where the pet people go. If you want to make a real difference, create an exciting career path, feel welcome to be your whole self and nurture your wellbeing, Petco is the place for you.


Our core values capture that spirit as we work to improve lives by doing what’s right for pets and people.


  • Pet First – Protect & Empower. All pets should Live their Best Life. We put the needs of pets and pet parents at the center of everything we do.

  • Foster the Fun – Connect & Bond. Our Passion for pets brings us together! We celebrate the journey of pet parenthood through distinct experiences, products, and services.

  • Let’s Go! Own & Commit. We are stronger as One Petco team. We bring our unique superpowers and champion authenticity in everyone to drive success.

About Petco:


We’re proud to be "where the pets go" to find everything they need to live their best lives for more than 60 years — from their favorite meals and toys, to trusted supplies and expert support from people who get it, because we live it. We believe in the universal truths of pet parenthood — the boundless boops, missing slippers, late night zoomies and everything in between. And we’re here for it. Every tail wag, every vet visit, every step of the way. We are 29,000+ strong and together we nurture the pet-human bond in more than 1,500 Petco stores across the U.S., Mexico and Puerto Rico, 250+ Vetco Total Care hospitals, hundreds of preventive care clinics and eight distribution centers. In 1999, we founded Petco Love. Together, we support thousands of local animal welfare groups nationwide and have helped find homes for approximately 7 million animals through in-store adoption events.



As a Key Holder, you are a trusted member of the leadership team who helps ensure smooth daily operations, exceptional customer service, and a safe, secure environment for pets, partners, and customers.

You support store leadership by supervising partners, opening and closing the store, and serving as a point of contact when management is not present. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys leading on the floor, solving problems in the moment, and delivering a great experience every day.

  • Process transactions, refunds, and exchanges accurately and efficiently.
  • Act as the primary point of contact in the absence of store management.
  • Support sales initiatives and promotions to help achieve store goals.

Key Responsibilities

Store Operations, Merchandising & Inventory

  • Maintain merchandise presentation and in-stock conditions to Petco standards.
  • Ensure accurate pricing and signage throughout the store.
  • Assist with inventory counts, product replenishment, and shrink awareness.
  • Monitor merchandising and inventory conditions during shifts and escalate issues as needed.
  • Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and safety standards.

Customer Experience & Leadership

  • Address customer questions and resolve concerns promptly and professionally.
  • Model Petco’s selling behaviors and service expectations.
  • Provide guidance and direction to partners during assigned shifts.
  • Escalate concerns appropriately to store leadership.

What Success Looks Like

  • The store opens and closes safely and smoothly.
  • Merchandise is well-stocked, accurately priced, and visually appealing.
  • Inventory is handled accurately and with care.
  • Customers receive prompt, friendly, and knowledgeable service.
  • Partners feel supported and clear on expectations during each shift.

What You Bring

Experience & Skills

  • Previous retail experience required; key holder or supervisory experience preferred.
  • Strong leadership, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
  • Ability to multitask and thrive in a fast-paced environment.
  • Basic math skills and experience handling cash and transactions.
  • Reliable, responsible, and detail oriented.

Essential Functions & Work Environment

This role is primarily performed in a Pet Care Center retail environment. The Key Holder is expected to be regularly present on the sales floor, leading by example and engaging with partners, customers, and pets.

  • Majority of work is conducted indoors; however, occasional duties may require leaving the Pet Care Center for tasks such as bank deposits, merchandise transport, or community events.

  • Ability to safely lift and move merchandise, supplies, or animals weighing up to 50 pounds.
  • Regular engagement with customers on the sales floor, including providing customer assistance and performing cashiering and point-of-sale transactions.
  • Must be able to work in proximity to animals, including exposure to animal dander, odors, noises, and cleaning chemicals.
  • Flexible availability to support Pet Care Center operating hours, including evenings, weekends, and holidays.
  • A limited amount of travel may be required for training, meetings, or community engagement.

Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this role.

Why You’ll Love It Here

  • Purpose-driven work that makes a difference for pets and people.
  • Opportunities to build leadership skills and grow your career.
  • A collaborative, inclusive team culture.
  • A strong stepping stone for future leadership opportunities.

Job Description:

About the Role:

As Executive Director - Head of Aromatic Chemical Markets Research & Analysis, you will be a member of the research leadership team responsible for developing and stewarding market research and analysis for aromatic chemicals. You will report to the Vice President of Base Chemicals.

About the Team:

Dow Jones Energy delivers trusted price transparency, benchmarks, analytics, news, and insights across the global energy, chemicals, metals, and fuel supply value chains. Our offerings support institutional investors, analysts, and traders navigating spot, wholesale, and retail markets, as well as emerging segments tied to the global energy transition.

Through authoritative data, real-time intelligence, and deep market expertise, Dow Jones Energy enables financial professionals to mitigate risk and make high-stakes commercial decisions in volatile, fast-evolving global markets.

You Will:

  • Direct primary research focused on the global market coverage of aromatic chemicals; particularly, benzene, paraxylene, toluene and other xylenes

  • Oversee the price forecasting process of these areas and communicate key forecast messages internally and externally

  • Establish and maintain a reputation as a leader in aromatic chemicals coverage by overseeing and deploying subject matter experts to industry events, media opportunities, client engagements and internal functions

  • Build and maintain industry contact relationships across producers, consumers, traders, and the financial community

  • Collaborate with sales personnel to identify new business opportunities for sales and consulting engagements

  • Advise content leaders on research topics and ideas to improve existing weekly and monthly reports and strategic analyses

  • Act as a liaison between Dow Jones Energy & external suppliers

  • Develop market presentations and pursue opportunities to present information in client meetings and conferences

  • Ensure that the team follows Dow Jones Energy price discovery standards

title: Senior UX Researcher
description:
Why Join GEICO?

At GEICO, we offer a rewarding career where your ambitions are met with endless possibilities.

Every day we honor our iconic brand by offering quality coverage to millions of customers and being there when they need us most. We thrive on relentless innovation to exceed our customers' expectations while making a real impact on local communities nationwide.

Founded in 1936, GEICO is a member of the Berkshire Hathaway family of companies and one of the largest auto insurers in the United States. When you join our company, we want you to feel valued, supported, and proud to work here. That's why we offer the GEICO Pledge: Great Company, Great Culture, Great Rewards, and Great Careers.

GEICO is seeking a highly skilled and experienced Senior Researcher, UX Research. As a UX Researcher, you will have a critical role in shaping the user experience of our products and services by utilizing insightful research and data-driven insights.

This position is a hybrid role that requires to be on-site 2-3 days a week at one of the following locations: Bethesda, MD; Palo Alto, CA; Seattle, WA.

Job Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product managers, designers, and engineers, to execute research studies. Proactively identify research opportunities and following through the process from scope, execution, analysis, and delivery

  • Participate in all phases of the user research process, including user recruitment, study design, data collection, analysis, and reporting. Utilize various qualitative and quantitative research methods, such as usability testing, surveys, interviews, and competitive analysis, to gain deep insights into user needs and behaviors

  • Analyze research data, identify patterns, and generate actionable insights that drive actionable insights and informed design decisions. Communicate research findings to stakeholders clearly and compellingly through reports, presentations, and interactive workshops

  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, engineers, and other stakeholders to advocate for user-centered design principles. Act as a strategic partner, providing valuable insights and recommendations throughout the product development lifecycle

  • Stay current with the latest research methodologies, tools, and industry trends Continuously evaluate and improve research practices, ensuring the team has the right resources and techniques to deliver impactful results

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a related field

  • 5+ years of experience (or 3+ with Masters degree) in user experience research

  • 5+ years of experience in qualitative and quantitative research methods, including usability testing, surveys, interviews, and ethnographic research

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent years of experience in research

  • Strong expertise in both qualitative and quantitative research methods, including usability testing, surveys, interviews, and ethnographic research

  • Proficient in data analysis and visualization tools, such as PowerBI or Tableau

  • Have a solid understanding of user-centered design principles and methodologies.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convey complex research findings to both technical and non-technical audiences

  • Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional teams and drive user-centric design decisions


Annual Salary

$109,675.00 - $172,200.00

The above annual salary range is a general guideline. Multiple factors are taken into consideration to arrive at the final hourly rate/ annual salary to be offered to the selected candidate. Factors include, but are not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the role, the selected candidate’s work experience, education and training, the work location as well as market and business considerations.

title: Ekspert(-ka) ds. płatności
description:
To masz na bank:

  • umowa o pracę,
  • praca hybrydowa częściowo w biurze w Warszawie, Plac Europejski 3A (przy Rondzie Daszyńskiego),
  • zespół/lider: Centre-Chapter Client Journeys and Customer Needs (Krzysztof Dąbek | LinkedIn),
  • cel: rozwój i optymalizacja usług oraz procesów płatniczych dla klientów indywidualnych przy współpracy z zespołami wewnętrznymi i Grupą Erste.

Jesteśmy bankiem z zapleczem technologicznym. W naszej centrali łączymy kilkanaście jednostek biznesowych. Choć jesteśmy zupełnie różni to mamy jeden cel - wszystko robimy na bank.

Na co dzień pracujemy w metodyce agile - w chapterach i squadach. Mamy też możliwość integracji z innymi pracownikami np. dzięki ponad 20 Klubom Zainteresowań.

Cenimy różnorodność wśród naszych pracowników. Wierzymy, że każdy, bez względu na indywidualne predyspozycje, każdy może wnieść niepowtarzalną perspektywę do naszej firmy.

Aplikuj, jeśli:

  • masz co najmniej 2-letnie doświadczenie w instytucji finansowej w obszarze tworzenia i wdrażania procesów, usług lub produktów dla klientów indywidualnych – mile widziane doświadczenie w obszarze płatności,
  • posiadasz wiedzę z zakresu płatności bezgotówkowych, przelewów, płatności mobilnych lub rozwiązań takich jak BLIK,
  • masz doświadczenie we współpracy z IT w procesie projektowania i wdrażania zmian - od analiz biznesowych / regulacyjnych / rynkowych przez przygotowanie wymagań / User Stories po wdrożenie i monitoring efektów,
  • posiadasz wiedzę i umiejętności z obszaru ścieżek klienta,
  • znasz regulacje dotyczące usług płatniczych i interesujesz się zmianami zachodzącymi na rynku płatności,
  • sprawnie posługujesz się narzędziami takimi jak MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint) oraz JIRA/Confluence,
  • potrafisz zarówno pracować w zespole, jak i samodzielnie oraz masz odwagę do podejmowania wyzwań,
  • masz doświadczenie w pracy w metodyce Agile, np. w ramach projektów,
  • posiadasz wykształcenie wyższe,
  • dobrze znasz język angielski.

Twoje zadania w tej roli:

  • projektowanie, rozwijanie i optymalizowanie usług oraz procesów płatniczych dla klientów indywidualnych,
  • prowadzenie projektów wdrożeniowych dotyczących zmian w obszarze płatności, w szczególności płatności mobilnych, BLIK-a, przelewów krajowych i zagranicznych oraz innych rozwiązań płatniczych,
  • analiza wymogów regulacyjnych, biznesowych i technologicznych oraz ich przekładanie na rozwiązania produktowe i procesowe,
  • przygotowywanie wymagań biznesowych i współpraca z zespołami IT przy realizacji zmian systemowych,
  • monitorowanie efektów wdrożeń oraz identyfikowanie obszarów do dalszej optymalizacji,
  • współpraca w dynamicznym zespole odpowiedzialnym biznesowo za rozwój usług płatniczych dla klientów indywidualnych,
  • współpraca z Grupą Erste przy tworzeniu koncepcji i wdrażaniu nowych rozwiązań płatniczych.

Na bank zadbamy dla Ciebie o:

  • umowę o pracę,
  • pracę w trybie hybrydowym w (lokalizacja na początku oferty),
  • prywatną opiekę medyczną Medicover (z możliwością wykupienia pakietu stomatologicznego),
  • system kafeteryjny z punktami do wymiany na aktywności, np. wypoczynkowe, kulturalne, gastronomiczne lub dofinansowanie do przedszkola/żłobka/klubu dziecięcego,
  • kartę Multisport,
  • ofertę produktową banku oraz pożyczki na pracowniczych warunkach,
  • aktywności wellbeingowe, np. Kluby Zainteresowań, webinary, ćwiczenia, podcasty; inicjatywy w biurach np. mammobus, profilaktyczne badanie wzroku, warsztaty z samoobrony,
  • wyprawkę dla dzieci,
  • benefity dla osób z niepełnosprawnościami: dodatek finansowy na cele prozdrowotne, dodatkowe 2 dni urlopu dla pracowników z lekkim stopniem niepełnosprawności, całkowita praca zdalna, jeśli charakter pracy na to pozwala,
  • platformę ze szkoleniami zewnętrznymi i wewnętrznymi – np. programowanie czy analiza danych lub komunikacja, podejście strategiczne, negocjacje i inne,
  • program poleceń pracowniczych – nagrodę pieniężną za polecenie osoby do pracy w banku.

Jak wygląda wdrożenie i rozwój?

  • Na bank nie rzucimy Cię na głęboką wodę. Zaplanowaliśmy wdrożenie, które obejmować będzie wprowadzenie do organizacji, Twojej jednostki biznesowej i zadań.
  • Przez początkowy okres pracy będzie towarzyszył Ci Buddy, który pokaże Ci naszą kulturę organizacyjną i odpowie na wszystkie pytania.

Dołącz do nas w kilku krokach:

  • Wyślij CV do naszej analizy, a my podejmiemy decyzję czy zaprosimy Cię do kolejnego etapu.
  • Spotkaj się (online) z rekruterem(-ką) i managerem(-ką).
  • Wykonaj zadanie merytoryczne/test (w zależności od stanowiska).
  • Pracuj z nami w naszym zespole!

Po każdym z etapów rekrutacji otrzymasz od nas informację zwrotną, dostosowaną do jego poziomu zaawansowania. Po spotkaniach zaś wrócimy do Ciebie z kompleksowym podsumowaniem mailowym lub telefonicznym.

Stosujemy najwyższe standardy zarządzania ryzykiem, dbamy o bezpieczeństwo naszych klientów i świadczonych usług.

title: Senior UX Designer / Scrum Master - CHEC
description:
Inside the Role

Inside the Role

The Custom Hardware and Electronics Configurator (CHEC) team builds and maintains DTNA's proprietary web-based tool that enables Truck Equipment Manufacturers (TEMs), dealers, and internal teams to configure and validate vehicle electrical features. CHEC operates in a safety-relevant, high-complexity domain where usability, correctness, and delivery discipline are critical.

We are looking for a Senior UX Designer / Scrum Master to own the user experience strategy for the CHEC platform while also serving as the primary Agile facilitator for the CHEC Dev/Ops team. This role is approximately 70% UX Design and 30% Scrum Master & Agile Facilitation. You will design intuitive workflows for complex configuration tasks, establish reusable UX patterns and safety-oriented design standards, and partner with React/.NET engineers to bring designs to life. On the Agile side, you will facilitate ceremonies, partner with Product Owners on backlog refinement, and promote continuous improvement. AI fluency is a core competency on this team - you will leverage AI tools daily to accelerate research, ideation, and design workflows.

Posting Information

We provide a scheduled posting end date to assist our candidates with their application planning. While this date reflects our latest plans, it is subject to change, and postings may be extended or removed earlier than expected.

We Take Care of Our Team

Position offers a starting salary range of $117,000 – $150,000 USD

Pay offered dependent on knowledge, skills, and experience.

Benefits include annual bonus program; 401k company contribution with company match up to 6% as well as non-elective company contribution of 3 - 7% depending on age; starting at 4 weeks paid vacation; 13+ calendar holidays; 8 weeks paid parental leave; employee assistance program; comprehensive healthcare plans and wellness programs; onsite fitness (at some locations); tuition assistance and volunteer paid time off; short-term and long-term disability plans.

What You Drive at DTNA

  • Own end-to-end UX for the CHEC web application

  • Design intuitive workflows for complex configuration tasks (logic creation, PTO setup, dash switch & gauge layouts)

  • Create wireframes, interaction models, and high-fidelity prototypes

  • Establish and maintain reusable UX patterns and safety-oriented design standards

  • Partner with React/.NET engineers to ensure high-quality implementation

  • Conduct usability testing with internal users, dealers, and TEMs

  • Leverage AI tools (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT) to accelerate UX research synthesis, persona development, and ideation workflows

  • Explore and integrate AI-assisted prototyping and design tools to increase iteration speed

  • Serve as Scrum Master for the CHEC Dev/Ops team

  • Facilitate core Agile ceremonies (Sprint Planning, Daily Standups, Reviews, Retrospectives)

  • Partner with Product Owners to refine backlog items and acceptance criteria

  • Identify and help remove impediments affecting delivery

  • Promote Agile best practices and continuous improvement

  • Ensure transparency on progress, risks, and dependencies

  • Champion adoption of AI-augmented development practices across the team

Knowledge You Should Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related field

  • 7+ years of UX design experience on complex enterprise or technical web applications

  • Strong background in interaction design and information architecture

  • Hands-on experience working in Agile / Scrum teams

  • Strong facilitation and communication skills

  • Demonstrated proficiency with AI-assisted design and research tools (e.g., Claude, Midjourney, Figma AI features)

  • Foundational prompt engineering skills - ability to craft effective prompts for research synthesis, content generation, and design exploration

  • Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and refine them to meet UX quality standards

Exceptional Candidates Might Have

  • Prior experience as a Scrum Master or Agile facilitator

  • Experience with configuration tools, engineering, or safety-relevant systems

  • Familiarity with React-based design systems

  • Scrum Master certification (CSM or equivalent)

  • Experience using AI coding assistants (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to support design-to-development handoff

  • Track record of integrating AI tools into UX workflows to measurably accelerate research and design delivery

  • Familiarity with prompt design for user-facing AI features

Fort Mill, SC US, Portland, OR US. Relocation assistance is not available for this position.

Schedule Type:

Hybrid (4 days per week in-office / 1 day remote). This schedule builds our #OneTeamBestTeam culture, provides an unparalleled customer experience, and creates innovative solutions through in-person collaboration.

At Daimler Truck North America, we recognize our world is changing faster than ever before. By listening to the needs of today, we’re building to solve with cutting-edge solutions in sustainability and future driving technology across electric, hydrogen and autonomous. These solutions, backed by years of innovative success and achievement, continue DTNA’s legacy as the undisputed industry leader. Our evolving brand portfolio is second to none, including Freightliner Trucks, Western Star, Demand Detroit, Thomas Built Buses, Freightliner Custom Chassis, and Financial Services. title: Equipment Application Engineer
description:
Brooks is a leading provider of automation solutions with over 40 years of experience in the semiconductor industry, offering precision robotics, integrated automation systems, and contamination control solutions that empower chip manufacturers worldwide. Our product portfolio includes a range of automation solutions, including robots, vacuum systems, and atmospheric robots for semiconductor manufacturing (www.brooks.com).

Are you looking for a place where you can be part of a transformation? Join us at Brooks Automation and be a part of a dynamic organization that is shaping the future of technology.

Equipment Application Engineer

Job Description

About Us

Brooks Automation is a growing, fast-paced technology leader supporting the dynamic and expanding semiconductor market. At Brooks, new ideas, technologies, and ways of thinking are shaping our future. Our customer-focused culture encourages employees to embrace innovation and collaborate closely to achieve outstanding results.

We are seeking a highly motivated Equipment Application Engineer to join our team and contribute to the deployment and optimization of advanced contamination control solutions.

Your Responsibilities

  • Provide technical support for equipment applications, assisting customers with the deployment, optimization, and maintenance of AMC (Airborne Molecular Contamination) control systems.
  • Analyze equipment operation data to identify, resolve, and prevent AMC-related issues.
  • Collaborate with process, equipment, and quality engineers to integrate cross-functional requirements and deliver technical solutions.
  • Participate in equipment testing, validation, and troubleshooting to ensure system stability and performance.
  • Prepare technical documentation, operation manuals, and customer reports; deliver training and technical presentations.
  • Support new product introduction (NPI) and customer site evaluations, including equipment installation, calibration, and functional verification.
  • Conduct regular customer visits to understand usage scenarios and pain points, providing feedback for product design and feature enhancements.
  • Participate in project planning and progress tracking to ensure quality and timely delivery.
  • Willingness to travel domestically and internationally to support customer site requirements.
  • Capable of equipment maintenance and modification.

Your Profile

  • Bachelor’s degree or above in engineering-related fields such as Mechanical, Electrical, Materials, Chemical Engineering, or equivalent.
  • Minimum 4+ years of experience in the semiconductor industry, with a background in equipment engineering, process integration, or technical support.
  • Familiarity with semiconductor process equipment (e.g., FOUP systems, AMC control units, gas analyzers) and their applications.
  • Experience with equipment validation processes, FAT/SAT, DOE design, and data analysis tools (e.g., Excel, JMP).
  • Excellent cross-functional communication and coordination skills to align requirements and drive project execution.
  • Proficient in technical writing and capable of communicating effectively with international customers in English.
  • Knowledge of cleanroom protocols and relevant standards such as ESD and safety compliance is preferred.
  • Self-motivated, eager to learn, and adaptable to new technologies and challenges.

What We Offer

  • Responsibility for technically challenging projects with significant scope for shaping outcomes.
  • Collaboration with international customers and external manufacturing partners.
  • A modern work environment with short decision‑making paths.
  • Personal and professional development opportunities in project and program management.
  • Attractive compensation and flexible working conditions.
